text: Quran-e-Hakim shifa hai. Maqamat-o-maratib-o-kaifiyat-e-wahi ka bayan ho raha hai ke kabhi toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dil mein wahi daal di jati hai jis ke wahi-e-Allah hone mein aapko koi shak nahin rehta, jaise Sahih Ibn-e-Hibban ki hadith mein hai ke Rooh-ul-Qudus ne mere dil mein yeh baat phonki hai ke koi shakhs bhi jab tak apni rozi aur apna waqt poora na kar le hargiz nahin marta, pas Allah se daro aur rozi ki talab mein achhai ikhtiyar karo. Ya parde ki oat se jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) se kalam hua. Kyunke unhon ne kalam sun kar jamal dekhna chaha lekin woh parde mein tha. Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) se farmaya tha ke Allah Ta'ala ne kisi se kalam nahin kiya magar parde ke peeche se, lekin tere baap se apne samne kalam kiya. Yeh Jannat-e-Uhud mein kuffar ke hathon shaheed kiye gaye thay, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke yeh kalam-e-alam-e-barzakh ka hai aur aayat mein jis kalam ka zikr hai us se murad duniya ka kalam hai. Ya apne qasid ko bhej kar apni baat us tak pahunchaye jaise Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S / Alaihis Salam) waghera farishtay ambiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) ke paas aate rahe. Woh ulu aur bulandi aur buzurgi wala hai, sath hi Hakim aur hikmat wala hai. Rooh se murad Quran hai. Farmata hai is Quran ko bazariya-e-wahi ke hum ne teri taraf utara hai. Kitab aur iman ko jis tafseel ke sath bayan kiya hum ne apni kitab mein hai, toh is se pehle janta bhi na tha lekin hum ne is Quran ko noor banaya hai taake is ke zariye se hum apne imandar bandon ko rah-e-rast dikhlayein. Jaise aayat mein hai (Qul huwa lilladhina amanu hudan wa shifa'un) (Surah Fussilat: 44) keh de ke yeh iman walon ke waste hidayat-o-shifa hai aur be-imanon ke kaan behre aur aankhein andhi hain. Phir farmaya ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum sarih aur mazboot haq ki rehnumai kar rahe ho. Phir Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tashreeh ki aur farmaya ise shar'a muqarrar karne wala khud Allah hai jis ki shaan yeh hai ke aasmanon zameenon ka malik aur Rabb wahi hai, in mein tasarruf karne wala aur hukum chalane wala bhi wahi hai. Koi us ke kisi hukum ko taal nahin sakta, tamam umoor us ki taraf phere jate hain, wahi sab kamon ke faisle karta hai aur hukum karta hai. Woh paak aur bartar hai har us cheez se jo us ki nisbat zalim aur munkireen kehte hain, woh bulandiyon aur badaiyon wala hai.

Quran ki qasam khai jo wazeh hai jis ke ma'ani roshan hain jis ke alfaaz noorani hain jo sab se zyada faseeh-o-baleeh Arabi zaban mein nazil hua hai yeh is liye ke log sochein samjhein aur wa'z-o-pand naseehat-o-ibrat hasil karein. Hum ne is Quran ko Arabi zaban mein nazil farmaya hai jaise aur jagah hai Arabi wazeh zaban mein ise nazil farmaya hai, is ki sharafat-o-martabat jo aalam-e-bala mein hai ise bayan farmaya taake zameen wale is ki manzilat-o-tauqeer maloom kar lein. Farmaya ke yeh Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein likha hua hai (Ladaina) se murad hamare paas (La'ali) se murad martabe wala izzat wala sharafat aur fazeelat wala hai. (Hakeem) se murad (Muhkam) mazboot jo batil ke milne aur na-haq se khalt-malt ho jane se paak hai aur aayat mein is paak kalam ki buzurgi ka bayan in alfaaz mein hai aayat (Innahu la-quranun kareem) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 77), aur jagah hai aayat (Kalla innaha tazkirah) (Surah Abasa: 11), yani yeh Quran-e-Kareem Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein darj hai ise bajuz paak farishton ke aur koi haath laga nahin pata yeh Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki taraf se utra hua hai aur farmaya Quran naseehat ki cheez hai jis ka jee chahe ise qabool kare woh aise saheefon mein se hai jo mu'azzaz hain buland martaba hain aur muqaddas hain jo aise likhne walon ke hathon mein hain jo zi-izzat aur paak hain. In dono aayaton se ulama ne istinbat kiya hai ke be-wazu Quran-e-Kareem ko haath mein nahin lena chahiye jaise ke ek hadees mein bhi aaya hai bashart-e-ke woh sahih sabit ho jaye. Is liye ke aalam-e-bala mein farishte is kitab ki izzat-o-ta'zeem karte hain jis mein yeh Quran likha hua hai. Pas is aalam mein hamein bator-e-aula is ki bahut zyada takreem-o-ta'zeem karni chahiye kyunke yeh zameen walon ki taraf hi bheja gaya hai aur is ka khitab inhi se hai to unhein is ki bahut zyada ta'zeem aur adab karna chahiye aur saath hi is ke ahkaam ko tasleem kar ke un par aamil ban jana chahiye kyunke Rabb ka farman hai ke yeh hamare haan Umm-ul-Kitab mein hai aur buland paya aur ba-hikmat hai. Is ke baad ki aayat ke ek ma'ani to yeh kiye gaye hain ke kya tum ne yeh samajh rakha hai ke bawajood ita'at guzari aur farmanbardari na karne ke hum tum ko chhor denge aur tumhein azaab na karenge? Dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke is ummat ke pehle guzarne walon ne jab is Quran ko jhutlaya usi waqt agar yeh utha liya jata to tamam duniya halak kar di jati lekin Allah ki wasee rahmat ne ise pasand na farmaya aur barabar bees saal se zyada tak yeh Quran utarta raha. Is qaul ka matlab yeh hai ke yeh Allah ki lutf-o-rahmat hai ke woh na manne walon ke inkar aur bad-batin logon ki shararat ki wajah se unhein naseehat-o-mau'izat karni nahin chhorta taake jo un mein neki wale hain woh durust ho jayen aur jo durust nahin hote un par hujjat tamam ho jaye. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Nabi-e-Akram Aan-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli deta hai aur farmata hai ke aap apni qaum ki takzeeb par ghabrayein nahin. Sabr-o-bardasht kijiye.

Farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekha ke aap ne yeh sab kuch kiya phir hans diye to main ne bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yahi sawal kiya aap ne jawab diya ke jab bande ke munh se Allah Ta'ala sunta hai ke woh kehta hai (Rabbighfirli) mere Rab mujhe bakhash de to woh bahut hi khush hota hai aur farmata hai mera banda jaanta hai ke mere siwa koi gunahon ko bakhash nahin sakta. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi hai. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih batlate hain. Aur hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ko apni sawari par apne peeche bithaya theek jab baith gaye to aap ne teen martaba (Allahu Akbar) ka, teen martaba (SubhanAllah) aur ek martaba (La ilaha illallah) kaha phir is par chit letne ki tarah ho kar hans diye aur Hazrat Abdullah ki taraf mutawajja ho kar farmane lage jo shakhs kisi janwar par sawar ho kar is tarah kare jis tarah main ne kiya to Allah Azza-wa-Jal us ki taraf mutawajja ho kar isi tarah hans deta hai jis tarah main teri taraf dekh kar hansa (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmate hain ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab kabhi apni sawari par sawar hote teen martaba takbeer keh kar in dono aayat-e-Qurani ki tilawat karte phir yeh dua maangte (Allahumma inni as'aluka fi safari hadhal birra wat-taqwa wa minal 'amali ma tarda, Allahumma hawwin 'alainas-safara watwi 'annal bu'd, Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahli, Allahummas-habna fi safarina wakhlufna fi ahlina) ya Allah main tujh se apne is safar mein neki aur parhezgari ka talib hoon aur un a'maal ka jin se tu khush ho jaye ae Allah hum par hamara safar aasaan kar de aur hamare liye doori ko lapet le parwardigar tu hi safar ka saathi aur ahl-o-ayal ka nigahban hai mere mabood hamare safar mein hamara saath de aur hamare gharon mein hamari jaanasheeni farma. Aur jab aap safar se wapas ghar ki taraf laut-te to farmate dua (Aayibuna ta'ibuna insha'Allah 'abiduna li-rabbina hamidun) yani wapas lautne wale tauba karne wale insha'Allah ibadatein karne wale apne Rab ki tareefein karne wale (Muslim, Abu Dawood, Nasai waghera). Abu Las al-Khuza'i farmate hain sadqe ke oonton mein se ek oont Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamari sawari ke liye hamein ata farmaya ke hum is par sawar ho kar Hajj ko jayen hum ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum nahin dekhte ke aap hamein is par sawar karayen. Aap ne farmaya suno har oont ki kohan mein shaitan hota hai tum jab is par sawar ho to jis tarah main tumhein hukm deta hoon Allah Ta'ala ka naam yaad karo phir ise apne liye khadim bana lo, yaad rakho Allah Ta'ala hi sawar karata hai. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abu Las ka naam Muhammad bin Aswad bin Khalaf hai (R.A). Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har oont ki peeth par shaitan hai to tum jab is par sawari karo to Allah ka naam liya karo phir apni hajaton mein kami na karo.

Mushrikeen ka badtareen fe'l Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ke is iftira aur kazb ka bayan farmata hai jo unhon ne Allah ke naam mansoob kar rakha hai jis ka zikr Surah An'am ki aayat (وَجَعَلُوْا لِلّٰهِ مِمَّا ذَرَاَ مِنَ الْحَرْثِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ نَصِيْبًا فَقَالُوْا ھٰذَا لِلّٰهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَھٰذَا لِشُرَكَاۗىِٕنَا ۚ فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَاۗىِٕهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ اِلٰي شُرَكَاۗىِٕهِمْ ۭسَاۗءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 136) mein hai yani Allah Ta'ala ne jo kheti aur maweshi paida kiye hain un mushrikeen ne un mein se kuch hissa toh Allah ka muqarrar kiya aur apne taur par keh diya ke yeh toh Allah ka hai aur yeh hamare maboodon ka, ab jo un ke maboodon ke naam ka hai woh toh Allah ki taraf nahin pahunchta aur jo har cheez Allah ki hoti hai woh un ke maboodon ko pahunch jati hai, un ki yeh tajweez kaisi buri hai? Isi tarah mushrikeen ne ladke ladkiyon ki taqseem kar ke ladkiyan toh Allah se mutaliq kar dein jo un ke khayal mein zaleel-o-khwar thin aur ladke apne liye pasand kiye, jaise ke Bari Ta'ala ka farman hai (اَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْاُنْثٰى) (Surah An-Najm: 21) kya tumhare liye toh bete hon aur Allah ke liye betiyan? Yeh toh badi bedhangi taqseem hai. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke in mushrikeen ne Allah ke bandon ko Allah ka juz qarar de liya hai, phir farmata hai ke in ki is badtameezi ko dekho ke jab yeh ladkiyon ko khud apne liye na-pasand karte hain phir Allah Ta'ala ke liye kaise pasand karte hain? In ki yeh halat hai ke jab in mein se kisi ko yeh khabar pahunchti hai ke tere yahan ladki hui toh munh basoor leta hai, goya ek sharmanak andoh-nak khabar suni, kisi se zikr tak nahin karta, andar hi andar kudhta rehta hai, zara sa munh nikal aata hai. Lekin phir apni kamil hamaqat ka muzahira karne baithta hai aur kehta hai ke Allah ki ladkiyan hain, yeh khoob maze ki baat hai ke khud jis cheez se ghabrayein Allah ke liye woh sabit karein. Phir farmata hai auratein naqis samjhi jati hain jin ke nuqsanat ki talafi zewarat aur aaraish se ki jati hai aur bachpan se marte dam tak woh banao-singhar ki mohtaj samjhi jati hain, phir behas-mubahise aur ladai jhagde ke waqt un ki zaban nahin chalti, daleel nahin de sakte, aajiz reh jati hain, maghloob ho jati hain, aisi cheez ko Janab-e-Bari Aali-o-Azeem ki taraf mansoob karte hain jo zahiri aur batini nuqsan apne andar rakhti hain. Jis ke zahiri nuqsan ko zeenat aur zewarat se door karne ki koshish ki jati hai, jaise ke ba'az Arab shairon ke ashaar hain: (Wa mal-hulu illa zeenatun min naqisatin, yutammimu min husnin izal-husnu qasara. Wa amma izal-kana al-jamalu muwaffaran, kahusnika lam yahtaju ila an yuzawwara) yani zewarat kami-e-husn ko poora karne ke liye hote hain. Bharpoor jamal ko zewarat ki kya zaroorat?

Aur batini nuqsan bhi hain jaise badla na le sakna na zaban se na himmat se. In mazmoon ko bhi Arabon ne ada kiya hai jabke yeh sirf rone dhone se hi madad kar sakti hai aur chori chhupe koi bhalai kar sakti hai. Phir farmata hai ke unhon ne farishton ko auratein samajh rakha hai, un se poocho ke kya jab woh paida hue to tum wahan maujood thay? Tum yeh na samjho ke hum tumhari in baton se be-khabar hain, sab hamare paas likhi hui hain aur Qayamat ke din tum se in ka sawal bhi hoga jis se tumhein darna chahiye aur hoshiyar rehna chahiye. Phir un ki mazeed hamaqat bayan farmata hai ke kehte hain hum ne farishton ko auratein samjha, phir un ki mooratein banayin aur phir unhein pooj rahe hain. Agar Allah chahta to hum mein un mein hail ho jata aur hum unhein na pooj sakte. Pas jabke hum unhein pooj rahe hain aur Allah hum mein aur un mein hail nahin hota to zahir hai ke hamari yeh pooja ghalat nahin balkay sahih hai. Pas pehli khata to un ki yeh ke Allah ke liye aulad sabit ki, dusri khata yeh ke farishton ko Allah ki ladkiyan qarar dein, teesri khata yeh ke inhi ki pooja paat shuru kar di. Jis par koi daleel-o-hujjat nahin, sirf apne badon aur aglon aur baap dadon ki korana taqleed hai. Chauthi khata yeh ke isay Allah ki taraf se muqaddar mana aur is se yeh natija nikala ke agar Rabb is se na-khush hota to hamein itni taqat hi na deta ke hum un ki parastish karein aur yeh un ki sareeh jahalat-o-khabasat hai. Allah Ta'ala is se sarasar na-khush hai. Ek ek paighambar is ki tardeed karta raha, ek ek kitab is ki burai bayan karti rahi, jaise farman hai (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut, faminhum man hadallahu wa minhum man haqqat 'alaihid dalalah, faseeru fil ardi fanzuru kaifa kana 'aqibatul mukazzibeen) (16-An-Nahl: 36), yani har ummat mein hum ne rasool bheja ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa dusre ki ibadat se bacho. Phir ba'az to aise nikle jinhein Allah ne hidayat ki aur ba'az aise bhi nikle jin par gumrahi ki baat sabit ho chuki, tum zameen mein chal phir kar dekho ke jhutlane walon ka kaisa bura hashr hua? Aur aayat mein hai (Was'al man arsalna min qablika mir rusulina aja'alna min dunir rahmani alihatan yu'badun) (43-Az-Zukhruf: 45), yani tu un rasoolon se pooch le jinhein hum ne tujh se pehle bheja tha, kya hum ne apne siwa dusron ki parastish ki unhein ijazat di thi? Phir farmata hai yeh daleel to un ki badi bodi hai aur bodi yun hai ke yeh be-ilm hain, baatein bana lete hain aur jhoot bol lete hain, yani yeh Allah ki is par qudrat ko nahin jante.

Imam-ul-Muwahhideen ka zikr aur duniya ki qeemat. Quraishi kuffar neki aur deen ke aitbar se chunke Khalilullah Imam-ul-Hunafa Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ki taraf mansoob thay is liye Allah Ta'ala ne sunnat-e-Ibrahimi un ke samne rakhi ke dekho jo apne bande aane wale tamam nabiyon ke baap, Allah ke Rasool, Imam-ul-Muwahhideen thay, unhon ne khule lafzon mein na sirf apni qoum se balkeh apne sagay baap se bhi keh diya ke mujh mein tum mein koi talluq nahin. Main siwaye apne sachay Allah ke jo mera khaliq aur haadi hai, tumhare in maboodon se bezar hoon, sab se be-talluq hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi un ki is jurrat-e-haq-goi aur josh-e-tauheed ka badla yeh diya ke kalma-e-tauheed ko un ki aulad mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh liya. Namumkin hai ke aap ki aulad mein is pak kalmay ke qail na hon, inhi ki aulad is tauheed-e-kalma ki isha'at karegi aur sa'eed roohein aur nek naseeb log isi gharanay se tauheed seekhein ge. Garz Islam aur tauheed ka mu'allim yeh gharana qarar pa gaya. Phir farmata hai baat yeh hai ke yeh kuffar kufr karte rahe aur main unhein mata-e-duniya deta raha, yeh aur behakte gaye aur is qadar bad-mast ban gaye ke jab un ke paas deen-e-haq aur Rasool-e-Haq aaye to unhon ne jhutlana shuru kar diya ke Kalam-e-Allah aur mojizat-e-ambiya jadoo hain aur hum un ke munkir hain. Sarkashi aur zid mein aa kar kufr kar baithe, inaad aur boghz se haq ke muqablay par utar aaye aur baatein banane lage ke kyun sahib agar yeh Quran sach-much Allah hi ka kalam hai to phir Makkah aur Taif ke kisi raees par, kisi baray aadmi par, kisi dunyawi wajahat walay par kyun na utra? Aur baray aadmi se un ki murad Walid bin Mughira, Urwa bin Mas'ood, Umair bin Amr, Utba bin Rabia, Habib bin Amr, Mabn-e-Abat-e-Yalil, Kinana bin Amr waghera se thi. Garz yeh thi ke in dono bastiyon mein se kisi baray martabay ke aadmi par Quran nazil hona chahiye tha. Is aitraz ke jawab mein farman-e-bari sarzad hota hai ke kya Rahmat-e-Ilahi ke yeh malik hain jo yeh isay taqseem karne baithe hain? Allah ki cheez Allah ki malkiyat, woh jisay chahe de, phir kahan is ka ilm aur kahan tumhara ilm? Usay bakhoobi maloom hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki risalat ka haqdar sahih ma'no mein kaun hai? Yeh ne'mat usi ko di jati hai jo tamam makhlooq se zyada pak dil ho, sab se zyada pak nafs ho, sab se barh kar ashraf ghar ka ho aur sab se zyada pak asal ka ho. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Rahmat-e-Allah ke taqseem karne walay kahan se ho gaye? Apni roziyan bhi in ke apne qabzay ki nahin, woh bhi in mein hum baant-te hain aur farq-o-tafawat ke sath jisay jab jitna chahein dein.

Jis se jab jo chahein chheen lein, aql-o-fahm, quwwat, taqat waghera bhi hamari hi di hui hai aur is mein bhi maratib-e-judagana hain. Is mein ek hikmat yeh bhi hai ke ek dusre se kaam le kyunke is ki use aur us ki use zaroorat aur haajat rehti hai, ek ek ke matahat rahe. Phir irshad hua ke tum jo kuch duniya jama kar rahe ho us ke muqable mein Rabb ki rahmat bahut hi behtar aur afzal hai. Zaan-baad Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar yeh baat na hoti ke log maal ko mera fazl aur meri razamandi ki daleel jaan kar maaldaron ke misl ban jayen to main to kuffar ko yeh duniya-e-don itni deta ke un ke ghar ki chhaten balkay un ke kothon ki seedhiyan bhi chandi ki hotin jin ke zariye yeh apne bala-khanon par pahunchte. Aur un ke gharon ke darwaze, un ke baithne ke takht bhi chandi ke hote aur sone ke bhi. Mere nazdeek duniya koi qadr ki cheez nahin, yeh faani hai, zail hone wali hai aur saari mil bhi jaye jab bhi aakhirat ke muqable mein bahut hi kam hai. In logon ki achhaiyon ke badle unhein yahin mil jate hain, khane peene, rehne sehne, baratne bartane mein kuch sahulaten baham pahunch jati hain. Aakhirat mein to mehez khaali haath honge, ek neki baqi na hogi jo Allah se kuch hasil kar sakein, jaise ke sahih hadith mein warid hua hai aur hadith mein hai agar duniya ki qadr Allah ke nazdeek ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi hoti to kisi kafir ko yahan paani ka ek ghont bhi na pilata. Phir farmaya aakhirat ki bhulaiyan sirf un ke liye nahin jo duniya mein phoonk phoonk ke qadam rakhte rahe, dar dar kar zindagi guzarte rahe, wahan Rabb ki khaas ne'matein aur makhsoos rahmaten jo unhein milengi un mein koi aur un ka shareek na hoga. Chunancha jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aap ke bala-khane mein gaye aur aap ne us waqt apni azwaj-e-mutahharat se eela kar rakha tha to dekha ke aap ek chatai ke tukde par lete hue hain jis ke nishan aap ke jism-e-mubarak par numayan hain to ro diye aur kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Qaisar-o-Kisra kis aan-baan aur kis shaan-o-shaukat se zindagi guzare rahe hain aur aap Allah ke barguzida pyare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar kis haal mein hain? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ya to takiya lagaye hue baithe hue the ya foran takiya chhod diya aur farmane lage ae Ibn-e-Khattab kya tu shak mein hai? Yeh to woh log hain jin ki nekiyan jaldi se yahin unhein mil gayin. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke kya tu is se khush nahin ke unhein duniya mile aur hamein aakhirat. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sone chandi ke bartanon mein nahin khao piyo, yeh duniya mein un ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamare liye hain aur duniya mein yeh un ke liye yun hain ke Rabb ki nazron mein duniya zaleel-o-khwar hai. Tirmidhi waghera ki ek hasan sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar duniya Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi waqat rakhti to kisi kafir ko kabhi bhi Allah Ta'ala ek ghont paani ka na pilata.

Jis se jab jo chahein chheen lein, aql-o-fahm, quwwat, taqat waghera bhi hamari hi di hui hai aur is mein bhi maratib-e-judagana hain. Is mein ek hikmat yeh bhi hai ke ek dusre se kaam le kyunke is ki use aur us ki use zaroorat aur haajat rehti hai, ek ek ke matahat rahe. Phir irshad hua ke tum jo kuch duniya jama kar rahe ho us ke muqable mein Rabb ki rahmat bahut hi behtar aur afzal hai. Zaan-baad Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar yeh baat na hoti ke log maal ko mera fazl aur meri razamandi ki daleel jaan kar maaldaron ke misl ban jayen to main to kuffar ko yeh duniya-e-don itni deta ke un ke ghar ki chhaten balkay un ke kothon ki seedhiyan bhi chandi ki hotin jin ke zariye yeh apne bala-khanon par pahunchte. Aur un ke gharon ke darwaze, un ke baithne ke takht bhi chandi ke hote aur sone ke bhi. Mere nazdeek duniya koi qadr ki cheez nahin, yeh faani hai, zail hone wali hai aur saari mil bhi jaye jab bhi aakhirat ke muqable mein bahut hi kam hai. In logon ki achhaiyon ke badle unhein yahin mil jate hain, khane peene, rehne sehne, baratne bartane mein kuch sahulaten baham pahunch jati hain. Aakhirat mein to mehez khaali haath honge, ek neki baqi na hogi jo Allah se kuch hasil kar sakein, jaise ke sahih hadith mein warid hua hai aur hadith mein hai agar duniya ki qadr Allah ke nazdeek ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi hoti to kisi kafir ko yahan paani ka ek ghont bhi na pilata. Phir farmaya aakhirat ki bhulaiyan sirf un ke liye nahin jo duniya mein phoonk phoonk ke qadam rakhte rahe, dar dar kar zindagi guzarte rahe, wahan Rabb ki khaas ne'matein aur makhsoos rahmaten jo unhein milengi un mein koi aur un ka shareek na hoga. Chunancha jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aap ke bala-khane mein gaye aur aap ne us waqt apni azwaj-e-mutahharat se eela kar rakha tha to dekha ke aap ek chatai ke tukde par lete hue hain jis ke nishan aap ke jism-e-mubarak par numayan hain to ro diye aur kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Qaisar-o-Kisra kis aan-baan aur kis shaan-o-shaukat se zindagi guzare rahe hain aur aap Allah ke barguzida pyare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar kis haal mein hain? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ya to takiya lagaye hue baithe hue the ya foran takiya chhod diya aur farmane lage ae Ibn-e-Khattab kya tu shak mein hai? Yeh to woh log hain jin ki nekiyan jaldi se yahin unhein mil gayin. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke kya tu is se khush nahin ke unhein duniya mile aur hamein aakhirat. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sone chandi ke bartanon mein nahin khao piyo, yeh duniya mein un ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamare liye hain aur duniya mein yeh un ke liye yun hain ke Rabb ki nazron mein duniya zaleel-o-khwar hai. Tirmidhi waghera ki ek hasan sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar duniya Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi waqat rakhti to kisi kafir ko kabhi bhi Allah Ta'ala ek ghont paani ka na pilata.

Quraishi kuffar neki aur deen ke aitbar se chunke Khalilullah Imam-ul-Hunafa Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ki taraf mansoob thay is liye Allah Ta'ala ne sunnat-e-Ibrahimi un ke samne rakhi ke dekho jo apne bande aane wale tamam nabiyon ke baap, Allah ke Rasool, Imam-ul-Muwahhideen thay, unhon ne khule lafzon mein na sirf apni qoum se balkeh apne sagay baap se bhi keh diya ke mujh mein tum mein koi talluq nahin. Main siwaye apne sachay Allah ke jo mera khaliq aur haadi hai, tumhare in maboodon se bezar hoon, sab se be-talluq hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi un ki is jurrat-e-haq-goi aur josh-e-tauheed ka badla yeh diya ke kalma-e-tauheed ko un ki aulad mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh liya. Namumkin hai ke aap ki aulad mein is pak kalmay ke qail na hon, inhi ki aulad is tauheed-e-kalma ki isha'at karegi aur sa'eed roohein aur nek naseeb log isi gharanay se tauheed seekhein ge. Garz Islam aur tauheed ka mu'allim yeh gharana qarar pa gaya. Phir farmata hai baat yeh hai ke yeh kuffar kufr karte rahe aur main unhein mata-e-duniya deta raha, yeh aur behakte gaye aur is qadar bad-mast ban gaye ke jab un ke paas deen-e-haq aur Rasool-e-Haq aaye to unhon ne jhutlana shuru kar diya ke Kalam-e-Allah aur mojizat-e-ambiya jadoo hain aur hum un ke munkir hain. Sarkashi aur zid mein aa kar kufr kar baithe, inaad aur boghz se haq ke muqablay par utar aaye aur baatein banane lage ke kyun sahib agar yeh Quran sach-much Allah hi ka kalam hai to phir Makkah aur Taif ke kisi raees par, kisi baray aadmi par, kisi dunyawi wajahat walay par kyun na utra? Allah ki cheez Allah ki malkiyat, woh jisay chahe de, phir kahan is ka ilm aur kahan tumhara ilm? Usay bakhoobi maloom hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki risalat ka haqdar sahih ma'no mein kaun hai? Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sone chandi ke bartanon mein nahin khao piyo, yeh duniya mein un ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamare liye hain aur duniya mein yeh un ke liye yun hain ke Rabb ki nazron mein duniya zaleel-o-khwar hai. Tirmidhi waghera ki ek hasan sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar duniya Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi waqat rakhti to kisi kafir ko kabhi bhi Allah Ta'ala ek ghont paani ka na pilata.

Imam-ul-Muwahhideen ka zikr aur duniya ki qeemat. Quraishi kuffar neki aur deen ke aitbar se chunke Khalilullah Imam-ul-Hunafa Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ki taraf mansoob thay is liye Allah Ta'ala ne sunnat-e-Ibrahimi un ke samne rakhi ke dekho jo apne bande aane wale tamam nabiyon ke baap, Allah ke Rasool, Imam-ul-Muwahhideen thay, unhon ne khule lafzon mein na sirf apni qoum se balkeh apne sagay baap se bhi keh diya ke mujh mein tum mein koi talluq nahin. Main siwaye apne sachay Allah ke jo mera khaliq aur haadi hai, tumhare in maboodon se bezar hoon, sab se be-talluq hoon. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi un ki is jurrat-e-haq-goi aur josh-e-tauheed ka badla yeh diya ke kalma-e-tauheed ko un ki aulad mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh liya. Namumkin hai ke aap ki aulad mein is pak kalmay ke qail na hon, inhi ki aulad is tauheed-e-kalma ki isha'at karegi aur sa'eed roohein aur nek naseeb log isi gharanay se tauheed seekhein ge. Garz Islam aur tauheed ka mu'allim yeh gharana qarar pa gaya. Phir farmata hai baat yeh hai ke yeh kuffar kufr karte rahe aur main unhein mata-e-duniya deta raha, yeh aur behakte gaye aur is qadar bad-mast ban gaye ke jab un ke paas deen-e-haq aur Rasool-e-Haq aaye to unhon ne jhutlana shuru kar diya ke Kalam-e-Allah aur mojizat-e-ambiya jadoo hain aur hum un ke munkir hain. Sarkashi aur zid mein aa kar kufr kar baithe, inaad aur boghz se haq ke muqablay par utar aaye aur baatein banane lage ke kyun sahib agar yeh Quran sach-much Allah hi ka kalam hai to phir Makkah aur Taif ke kisi raees par, kisi baray aadmi par, kisi dunyawi wajahat walay par kyun na utra? Aur baray aadmi se un ki murad Walid bin Mughira, Urwa bin Mas'ood, Umair bin Amr, Utba bin Rabia, Habib bin Amr, Mabn-e-Abat-e-Yalil, Kinana bin Amr waghera se thi. Garz yeh thi ke in dono bastiyon mein se kisi baray martabay ke aadmi par Quran nazil hona chahiye tha. Is aitraz ke jawab mein farman-e-bari sarzad hota hai ke kya Rahmat-e-Ilahi ke yeh malik hain jo yeh isay taqseem karne baithe hain? Allah ki cheez Allah ki malkiyat, woh jisay chahe de, phir kahan is ka ilm aur kahan tumhara ilm? Usay bakhoobi maloom hai ke Allah Ta'ala ki risalat ka haqdar sahih ma'no mein kaun hai? Yeh ne'mat usi ko di jati hai jo tamam makhlooq se zyada pak dil ho, sab se zyada pak nafs ho, sab se barh kar ashraf ghar ka ho aur sab se zyada pak asal ka ho. Phir farmata hai ke yeh Rahmat-e-Allah ke taqseem karne walay kahan se ho gaye? Apni roziyan bhi in ke apne qabzay ki nahin, woh bhi in mein hum baant-te hain aur farq-o-tafawat ke sath jisay jab jitna chahein dein.

Jis se jab jo chahein chheen lein, aql-o-fahm, quwwat, taqat waghera bhi hamari hi di hui hai aur is mein bhi maratib-e-judagana hain. Is mein ek hikmat yeh bhi hai ke ek dusre se kaam le kyunke is ki use aur us ki use zaroorat aur haajat rehti hai, ek ek ke matahat rahe. Phir irshad hua ke tum jo kuch duniya jama kar rahe ho us ke muqable mein Rabb ki rahmat bahut hi behtar aur afzal hai. Zaan-baad Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke agar yeh baat na hoti ke log maal ko mera fazl aur meri razamandi ki daleel jaan kar maaldaron ke misl ban jayen to main to kuffar ko yeh duniya-e-don itni deta ke un ke ghar ki chhaten balkay un ke kothon ki seedhiyan bhi chandi ki hotin jin ke zariye yeh apne bala-khanon par pahunchte. Aur un ke gharon ke darwaze, un ke baithne ke takht bhi chandi ke hote aur sone ke bhi. Mere nazdeek duniya koi qadr ki cheez nahin, yeh faani hai, zail hone wali hai aur saari mil bhi jaye jab bhi aakhirat ke muqable mein bahut hi kam hai. In logon ki achhaiyon ke badle unhein yahin mil jate hain, khane peene, rehne sehne, baratne bartane mein kuch sahulaten baham pahunch jati hain. Aakhirat mein to mehez khaali haath honge, ek neki baqi na hogi jo Allah se kuch hasil kar sakein, jaise ke sahih hadith mein warid hua hai aur hadith mein hai agar duniya ki qadr Allah ke nazdeek ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi hoti to kisi kafir ko yahan paani ka ek ghont bhi na pilata. Phir farmaya aakhirat ki bhulaiyan sirf un ke liye nahin jo duniya mein phoonk phoonk ke qadam rakhte rahe, dar dar kar zindagi guzarte rahe, wahan Rabb ki khaas ne'matein aur makhsoos rahmaten jo unhein milengi un mein koi aur un ka shareek na hoga. Chunancha jab Hazrat Umar (R.A) Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aap ke bala-khane mein gaye aur aap ne us waqt apni azwaj-e-mutahharat se eela kar rakha tha to dekha ke aap ek chatai ke tukde par lete hue hain jis ke nishan aap ke jism-e-mubarak par numayan hain to ro diye aur kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Qaisar-o-Kisra kis aan-baan aur kis shaan-o-shaukat se zindagi guzare rahe hain aur aap Allah ke barguzida pyare Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ho kar kis haal mein hain? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ya to takiya lagaye hue baithe hue the ya foran takiya chhod diya aur farmane lage ae Ibn-e-Khattab kya tu shak mein hai? Yeh to woh log hain jin ki nekiyan jaldi se yahin unhein mil gayin. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke kya tu is se khush nahin ke unhein duniya mile aur hamein aakhirat. Bukhari-o-Muslim waghera mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sone chandi ke bartanon mein nahin khao piyo, yeh duniya mein un ke liye hain aur aakhirat mein hamare liye hain aur duniya mein yeh un ke liye yun hain ke Rabb ki nazron mein duniya zaleel-o-khwar hai. Tirmidhi waghera ki ek hasan sahih hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agar duniya Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi waqat rakhti to kisi kafir ko kabhi bhi Allah Ta'ala ek ghont paani ka na pilata.

Shaitan se bacho. Irshad hota hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala Raheem-o-Kareem ke zikr se ghaflat-o-beraghibti kare us par Shaitan qabu pa leta hai aur uska sathi ban jata hai. Aankh ki beenai ki kami ko Arabi zaban mein (ashi fil ain) kehte hain. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aur bhi bahut si aayaton mein hai jaise farmaya aayat (Wa man yushaqiqir rasula mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahul huda wa yattabi' ghaira sabeelil mu'mineena nuwallihi ma tawalla wa nuslihi jahannam, wa sa'at maseera) (Surah An-Nisa: 115), yani jo shakhs hidayat zahir kar chukne ke baad mukhalifat-e-Rasool kar ke momino ki raah ke siwa dusri raah ki pairwi kare hum use wahin chhodenge aur Jahannam wasil karenge jo badi buri jagah hai. Aur aayat mein irshad hai (Falamma zaghu azaghallahu qulubahum, wallahu la yahdil qawmal fasiqeen) (Surah As-Saff: 5), yani jab wohi tedhe ho gaye Allah ne unke dil bhi kaj kar diye. Aur aayat mein farmaya (Wa qayyadna lahum qurana) al-kh, yani unke jo ham-nasheen hum ne muqarrar kar diye hain woh unke aage peeche ki cheezon ko zeenat wali bana kar unhein dikhate hain. Yahan irshad hota hai ke aise ghafil logon par Shaitan apna qabu kar leta hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ki raah se rokta hai aur unke dil mein yeh khayal jama deta hai ke unki raush bahut achi hai, yeh bilkul sahi deen par qaim hain. Qayamat ke din jab Allah ke samne hazir honge aur mamla khul jayega to apne is Shaitan se jo unke sath tha barat zahir karega aur kahega kaash ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan itna fasla hota jitna mashriq aur maghrib mein hai. Yahan ba-aitbar-e-ghalbe ke mashriqain yani do mashriqon ka lafz keh diya gaya hai jaise suraj chand ko qamrain yani do chand keh diya jata hai aur maa baap ko abwain yani do baap keh diya jata hai. Ek qirat mein (ja'ana) bhi hai yani Shaitan aur yeh ghafil insan dono jab hamare paas aayenge. Hazrat Saeed Jurairi R.H farmate hain ke kafir ke apni qabr se uthte hi Shaitan aakar uske haath se haath mila leta hai phir juda nahin hota yahan tak ke Jahannam mein bhi dono ko sath hi dala jata hai. Phir farmata hai ke Jahannam mein tum sab ka jama hona aur wahan ke azabon mein sab ka shareek hona tumhare liye nafa dene wala nahin. Iske baad apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke azali behron ke kaan mein aap hidayat ki aawaz nahin daal sakte, madar-zad andhon ko aap raah nahin dikha sakte, sareeh gumrahi mein pade hue aapki hidayat qubool nahin kar sakte. Yani tujh par hamari janib se yeh farz nahin ke khwah-makhwah har har shakhs musalman ho hi jaye, hidayat tere qabze ki cheez nahin. Jo haq ki taraf kaan hi na lagaye, jo seedhi raah ki taraf aankh hi na uthaye, jo behke aur usi mein khush rahe, tujhe unki babat kyun itna khayal hai?

Tujh par zaroori kaam sirf tabligh karna hai, hidayat-o-zalalat hamare haath ki cheezein hain. Aadil hain hum, Hakeem hain hum, jo chahenge karenge, tum tang-dil na ho jaya karo. Phir farmata hai ke agarche hum tujhe yahan se le jayen, phir bhi hum in zalimon se badla liye baghair toh rahenge nahin. Agar hum tujhe teri aankhon se woh dikha den jis ka wada hum ne in se kiya hai, toh hum is se aajiz nahin. Gharz is tarah aur is tarah dono suraton mein kuffar par azab toh aayega hi, lekin phir woh surat pasand ki gayi jis mein paighambar ki izzat zyada thi. Yani Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko faut na kiya jab tak ke aap ke dushmanon ko maghloob na kar diya, aap ki aankhein thandi na kar dein, aap in ki janon aur malon aur malkiyaton ke malik na ban gaye. Yeh toh hai tafsir Hazrat Suddi waghera ki, lekin Hazrat Qatada farmate hain Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya se utha liye gaye aur inteqam baqi reh gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko aap ki zindagi mein ummat mein woh mamlaat na dikhaye jo aap ki na-pasandida thay, bajuz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aur tamam ambiya ke samne un ki ummaton par azab aaye. Hum se yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jab se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom kara diya gaya ke aap ki ummat par kya kya wabaal aayenge, us waqt se le kar wisal ke waqt tak kabhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khul-khula kar hanste hue dekhe nahin gaye. Hazrat Hasan se bhi isi tarah ki riwayat hai. Ek hadith mein hai: Sitare aasman ke bachao ka sabab hain, jab sitare jhad jayenge toh aasman par musibat aa jayegi. Main apne ashab ka zariya-e-amn hoon, mere jane ke baad mere ashab par woh aa jayega jis ka yeh wada diye jate hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo Quran tujh par nazil kiya gaya hai, jo sarasar haq-o-sidq hai, jo haqaniyat ki seedhi aur saaf raah ki rahnumai karta hai, toh ise mazbooti ke sath liye reh. Yehi Jannat-e-Naeem aur Raah-e-Mustaqeem ka rehbar hai. Is par chalne wala, is ke ahkaam ko thamne wala behak aur bhatak nahin sakta. Yeh tere liye aur teri qoum ke liye zikr hai, yani sharaf aur buzurgi hai. Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh amr (yani khilafat-o-imamat) Quraish mein hi rahega, jo in se jhagdega aur chheene ga use Allah Ta'ala oondhe munh girayega jab tak deen ko qaim rakhein. Is liye bhi aap ki sharafat-e-qoumi is mein hai ke yeh Quran aap hi ki zaban mein utra hai. Lughat-e-Quraish mein hi nazil hua hai, toh zahir hai ke sab se zyada ise yehi samjhenge. Inhein laiq hai ke sab se zyada mazbooti ke sath amal bhi inhi ka is par rahe, bilkhusoos is mein badi bhari buzurgi hai un Muhajireen-e-Kiram ki jinhon ne awwal-awwal sabqat kar ke Islam qabool kiya aur hijrat mein bhi sab se pesh-pesh rahe aur jo in ke qadam-ba-qadam chale. Zikr ke ma'ani nasihat, na hone ke ma'ani mein nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laqad anzalna ilaikum kitaban feehi zikrukum, afala ta'qiloon) (21. Al-Anbiya: 10), yani bil-yaqeen hum ne tumhari taraf kitab nazil farmayi jis mein tumhare liye nasihat hai, kya pas tum aql nahin rakhte?

Aur aayat mein hai (Wa-anzir 'ashiratakal-aqrabin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 214) yani apne khandani qarabat-daron ko hoshiyar kar de. Garz nasihat-e-Qurani risalat-e-Nabawi aam hai, kunbay walon ko, qoum ko aur duniya ke kul logon ko shamil hai. Phir farmata hai tum se anqareeb sawal hoga ke kahan tak is Kalam-e-Allah Sharif par amal kiya aur kahan tak ise mana? Tamam rasoolon ne apni apni qoum ko wahi dawat di jo ae Aakhir-uz-Zaman Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap apni ummat ko de rahe hain. Kul ambiya ke dawat namon ka khulasa sirf is qadar hai ke unhon ne tawheed phailayi aur shirk ko khatam kiya, jaise khud Quran mein hai ke hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat na karo. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ki qirat mein yeh aayat is tarah hai (Was-al-alladhina arsalna ilayhim qablaka rusulana). Pas yeh misl-e-tafsir ke hai na tilawat ke, Wallahu A'lam. To matlab yeh hua ke un se daryaft kar le jin mein tujh se pehle hum apne aur rasoolon ko bhej chuke hain. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain nabiyon se pooch le, yani Meraj wali raat ko jab ke ambiya aap ke samne jama thay, ke har nabi tawheed sikhane aur shirk mitane ki hi taleem le kar hamari janib se mab'oos hota raha.

Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ki qirat mein yeh aayat is tarah hai (Was-al-alladhina arsalna ilayhim qablaka rusulana). Pas yeh misl-e-tafsir ke hai na tilawat ke, Wallahu A'lam. To matlab yeh hua ke un se daryaft kar le jin mein tujh se pehle hum apne aur rasoolon ko bhej chuke hain. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain nabiyon se pooch le, yani Meraj wali raat ko jab ke ambiya aap ke samne jama thay, ke har nabi tawheed sikhane aur shirk mitane ki hi taleem le kar hamari janib se mab'oos hota raha.

Shaitan se bacho. Irshad hota hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala Raheem-o-Kareem ke zikr se ghaflat-o-beraghibti kare us par Shaitan qabu pa leta hai aur uska sathi ban jata hai. Aankh ki beenai ki kami ko Arabi zaban mein (ashi fil ain) kehte hain. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aur bhi bahut si aayaton mein hai jaise farmaya aayat (Wa man yushaqiqir rasula mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahul huda wa yattabi' ghaira sabeelil mu'mineena nuwallihi ma tawalla wa nuslihi jahannam, wa sa'at maseera) (Surah An-Nisa: 115), yani jo shakhs hidayat zahir kar chukne ke baad mukhalifat-e-Rasool kar ke momino ki raah ke siwa dusri raah ki pairwi kare hum use wahin chhodenge aur Jahannam wasil karenge jo badi buri jagah hai. Aur aayat mein irshad hai (Falamma zaghu azaghallahu qulubahum, wallahu la yahdil qawmal fasiqeen) (Surah As-Saff: 5), yani jab wohi tedhe ho gaye Allah ne unke dil bhi kaj kar diye. Aur aayat mein farmaya (Wa qayyadna lahum qurana) al-kh, yani unke jo ham-nasheen hum ne muqarrar kar diye hain woh unke aage peeche ki cheezon ko zeenat wali bana kar unhein dikhate hain. Yahan irshad hota hai ke aise ghafil logon par Shaitan apna qabu kar leta hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ki raah se rokta hai aur unke dil mein yeh khayal jama deta hai ke unki raush bahut achi hai, yeh bilkul sahi deen par qaim hain. Qayamat ke din jab Allah ke samne hazir honge aur mamla khul jayega to apne is Shaitan se jo unke sath tha barat zahir karega aur kahega kaash ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan itna fasla hota jitna mashriq aur maghrib mein hai. Yahan ba-aitbar-e-ghalbe ke mashriqain yani do mashriqon ka lafz keh diya gaya hai jaise suraj chand ko qamrain yani do chand keh diya jata hai aur maa baap ko abwain yani do baap keh diya jata hai. Ek qirat mein (ja'ana) bhi hai yani Shaitan aur yeh ghafil insan dono jab hamare paas aayenge. Hazrat Saeed Jurairi R.H farmate hain ke kafir ke apni qabr se uthte hi Shaitan aakar uske haath se haath mila leta hai phir juda nahin hota yahan tak ke Jahannam mein bhi dono ko sath hi dala jata hai. Phir farmata hai ke Jahannam mein tum sab ka jama hona aur wahan ke azabon mein sab ka shareek hona tumhare liye nafa dene wala nahin. Iske baad apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke azali behron ke kaan mein aap hidayat ki aawaz nahin daal sakte, madar-zad andhon ko aap raah nahin dikha sakte, sareeh gumrahi mein pade hue aapki hidayat qubool nahin kar sakte. Yani tujh par hamari janib se yeh farz nahin ke khwah-makhwah har har shakhs musalman ho hi jaye, hidayat tere qabze ki cheez nahin. Jo haq ki taraf kaan hi na lagaye, jo seedhi raah ki taraf aankh hi na uthaye, jo behke aur usi mein khush rahe, tujhe unki babat kyun itna khayal hai?

Tujh par zaroori kaam sirf tabligh karna hai, hidayat-o-zalalat hamare haath ki cheezein hain. Aadil hain hum, Hakeem hain hum, jo chahenge karenge, tum tang-dil na ho jaya karo. Phir farmata hai ke agarche hum tujhe yahan se le jayen, phir bhi hum in zalimon se badla liye baghair toh rahenge nahin. Agar hum tujhe teri aankhon se woh dikha den jis ka wada hum ne in se kiya hai, toh hum is se aajiz nahin. Gharz is tarah aur is tarah dono suraton mein kuffar par azab toh aayega hi, lekin phir woh surat pasand ki gayi jis mein paighambar ki izzat zyada thi. Yani Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko faut na kiya jab tak ke aap ke dushmanon ko maghloob na kar diya, aap ki aankhein thandi na kar dein, aap in ki janon aur malon aur malkiyaton ke malik na ban gaye. Yeh toh hai tafsir Hazrat Suddi waghera ki, lekin Hazrat Qatada farmate hain Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya se utha liye gaye aur inteqam baqi reh gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko aap ki zindagi mein ummat mein woh mamlaat na dikhaye jo aap ki na-pasandida thay, bajuz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aur tamam ambiya ke samne un ki ummaton par azab aaye. Hum se yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jab se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom kara diya gaya ke aap ki ummat par kya kya wabaal aayenge, us waqt se le kar wisal ke waqt tak kabhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khul-khula kar hanste hue dekhe nahin gaye. Hazrat Hasan se bhi isi tarah ki riwayat hai. Ek hadith mein hai: Sitare aasman ke bachao ka sabab hain, jab sitare jhad jayenge toh aasman par musibat aa jayegi. Main apne ashab ka zariya-e-amn hoon, mere jane ke baad mere ashab par woh aa jayega jis ka yeh wada diye jate hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo Quran tujh par nazil kiya gaya hai, jo sarasar haq-o-sidq hai, jo haqaniyat ki seedhi aur saaf raah ki rahnumai karta hai, toh ise mazbooti ke sath liye reh. Yehi Jannat-e-Naeem aur Raah-e-Mustaqeem ka rehbar hai. Is par chalne wala, is ke ahkaam ko thamne wala behak aur bhatak nahin sakta. Yeh tere liye aur teri qoum ke liye zikr hai, yani sharaf aur buzurgi hai. Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh amr (yani khilafat-o-imamat) Quraish mein hi rahega, jo in se jhagdega aur chheene ga use Allah Ta'ala oondhe munh girayega jab tak deen ko qaim rakhein. Is liye bhi aap ki sharafat-e-qoumi is mein hai ke yeh Quran aap hi ki zaban mein utra hai. Lughat-e-Quraish mein hi nazil hua hai, toh zahir hai ke sab se zyada ise yehi samjhenge. Inhein laiq hai ke sab se zyada mazbooti ke sath amal bhi inhi ka is par rahe, bilkhusoos is mein badi bhari buzurgi hai un Muhajireen-e-Kiram ki jinhon ne awwal-awwal sabqat kar ke Islam qabool kiya aur hijrat mein bhi sab se pesh-pesh rahe aur jo in ke qadam-ba-qadam chale. Zikr ke ma'ani nasihat, na hone ke ma'ani mein nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laqad anzalna ilaikum kitaban feehi zikrukum, afala ta'qiloon) (21. Al-Anbiya: 10), yani bil-yaqeen hum ne tumhari taraf kitab nazil farmayi jis mein tumhare liye nasihat hai, kya pas tum aql nahin rakhte?

Hazrat Hasan se bhi isi tarah ki riwayat hai. Ek hadith mein hai: Sitare aasman ke bachao ka sabab hain, jab sitare jhad jayenge toh aasman par musibat aa jayegi. Main apne ashab ka zariya-e-amn hoon, mere jane ke baad mere ashab par woh aa jayega jis ka yeh wada diye jate hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo Quran tujh par nazil kiya gaya hai, jo sarasar haq-o-sidq hai, jo haqaniyat ki seedhi aur saaf raah ki rahnumai karta hai, toh ise mazbooti ke sath liye reh. Yehi Jannat-e-Naeem aur Raah-e-Mustaqeem ka rehbar hai. Is par chalne wala, is ke ahkaam ko thamne wala behak aur bhatak nahin sakta. Yeh tere liye aur teri qoum ke liye zikr hai, yani sharaf aur buzurgi hai. Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh amr (yani khilafat-o-imamat) Quraish mein hi rahega, jo in se jhagdega aur chheene ga use Allah Ta'ala oondhe munh girayega jab tak deen ko qaim rakhein. Is liye bhi aap ki sharafat-e-qoumi is mein hai ke yeh Quran aap hi ki zaban mein utra hai. Lughat-e-Quraish mein hi nazil hua hai, toh zahir hai ke sab se zyada ise yehi samjhenge. Inhein laiq hai ke sab se zyada mazbooti ke sath amal bhi inhi ka is par rahe, bilkhusoos is mein badi bhari buzurgi hai un Muhajireen-e-Kiram ki jinhon ne awwal-awwal sabqat kar ke Islam qabool kiya aur hijrat mein bhi sab se pesh-pesh rahe aur jo in ke qadam-ba-qadam chale. Zikr ke ma'ani nasihat, na hone ke ma'ani mein nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laqad anzalna ilaikum kitaban feehi zikrukum, afala ta'qiloon) (21. Al-Anbiya: 10), yani bil-yaqeen hum ne tumhari taraf kitab nazil farmayi jis mein tumhare liye nasihat hai, kya pas tum aql nahin rakhte?

Aur aayat mein hai (Wa-anzir 'ashiratakal-aqrabin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 214) yani apne khandani qarabat-daron ko hoshiyar kar de. Garz nasihat-e-Qurani risalat-e-Nabawi aam hai, kunbay walon ko, qoum ko aur duniya ke kul logon ko shamil hai. Phir farmata hai tum se anqareeb sawal hoga ke kahan tak is Kalam-e-Allah Sharif par amal kiya aur kahan tak ise mana? Tamam rasoolon ne apni apni qoum ko wahi dawat di jo ae Aakhir-uz-Zaman Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap apni ummat ko de rahe hain. Kul ambiya ke dawat namon ka khulasa sirf is qadar hai ke unhon ne tawheed phailayi aur shirk ko khatam kiya, jaise khud Quran mein hai ke hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat na karo. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ki qirat mein yeh aayat is tarah hai (Was-al-alladhina arsalna ilayhim qablaka rusulana). Pas yeh misl-e-tafsir ke hai na tilawat ke, Wallahu A'lam. To matlab yeh hua ke un se daryaft kar le jin mein tujh se pehle hum apne aur rasoolon ko bhej chuke hain. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain nabiyon se pooch le, yani Meraj wali raat ko jab ke ambiya aap ke samne jama thay, ke har nabi tawheed sikhane aur shirk mitane ki hi taleem le kar hamari janib se mab'oos hota raha.

Shaitan se bacho. Irshad hota hai ke jo shakhs Allah Ta'ala Raheem-o-Kareem ke zikr se ghaflat-o-beraghibti kare us par Shaitan qabu pa leta hai aur uska sathi ban jata hai. Aankh ki beenai ki kami ko Arabi zaban mein (ashi fil ain) kehte hain. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aur bhi bahut si aayaton mein hai jaise farmaya aayat (Wa man yushaqiqir rasula mim ba'di ma tabayyana lahul huda wa yattabi' ghaira sabeelil mu'mineena nuwallihi ma tawalla wa nuslihi jahannam, wa sa'at maseera) (Surah An-Nisa: 115), yani jo shakhs hidayat zahir kar chukne ke baad mukhalifat-e-Rasool kar ke momino ki raah ke siwa dusri raah ki pairwi kare hum use wahin chhodenge aur Jahannam wasil karenge jo badi buri jagah hai. Aur aayat mein irshad hai (Falamma zaghu azaghallahu qulubahum, wallahu la yahdil qawmal fasiqeen) (Surah As-Saff: 5), yani jab wohi tedhe ho gaye Allah ne unke dil bhi kaj kar diye. Aur aayat mein farmaya (Wa qayyadna lahum qurana) al-kh, yani unke jo ham-nasheen hum ne muqarrar kar diye hain woh unke aage peeche ki cheezon ko zeenat wali bana kar unhein dikhate hain. Yahan irshad hota hai ke aise ghafil logon par Shaitan apna qabu kar leta hai aur unhein Allah Ta'ala ki raah se rokta hai aur unke dil mein yeh khayal jama deta hai ke unki raush bahut achi hai, yeh bilkul sahi deen par qaim hain. Qayamat ke din jab Allah ke samne hazir honge aur mamla khul jayega to apne is Shaitan se jo unke sath tha barat zahir karega aur kahega kaash ke mere aur tumhare darmiyan itna fasla hota jitna mashriq aur maghrib mein hai. Yahan ba-aitbar-e-ghalbe ke mashriqain yani do mashriqon ka lafz keh diya gaya hai jaise suraj chand ko qamrain yani do chand keh diya jata hai aur maa baap ko abwain yani do baap keh diya jata hai. Ek qirat mein (ja'ana) bhi hai yani Shaitan aur yeh ghafil insan dono jab hamare paas aayenge. Hazrat Saeed Jurairi R.H farmate hain ke kafir ke apni qabr se uthte hi Shaitan aakar uske haath se haath mila leta hai phir juda nahin hota yahan tak ke Jahannam mein bhi dono ko sath hi dala jata hai. Phir farmata hai ke Jahannam mein tum sab ka jama hona aur wahan ke azabon mein sab ka shareek hona tumhare liye nafa dene wala nahin. Iske baad apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke azali behron ke kaan mein aap hidayat ki aawaz nahin daal sakte, madar-zad andhon ko aap raah nahin dikha sakte, sareeh gumrahi mein pade hue aapki hidayat qubool nahin kar sakte. Yani tujh par hamari janib se yeh farz nahin ke khwah-makhwah har har shakhs musalman ho hi jaye, hidayat tere qabze ki cheez nahin. Jo haq ki taraf kaan hi na lagaye, jo seedhi raah ki taraf aankh hi na uthaye, jo behke aur usi mein khush rahe, tujhe unki babat kyun itna khayal hai?

Hazrat Saeed Jurairi R.H farmate hain ke kafir ke apni qabr se uthte hi Shaitan aakar uske haath se haath mila leta hai phir juda nahin hota yahan tak ke Jahannam mein bhi dono ko sath hi dala jata hai. Phir farmata hai ke Jahannam mein tum sab ka jama hona aur wahan ke azabon mein sab ka shareek hona tumhare liye nafa dene wala nahin. Iske baad apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke azali behron ke kaan mein aap hidayat ki aawaz nahin daal sakte, madar-zad andhon ko aap raah nahin dikha sakte, sareeh gumrahi mein pade hue aapki hidayat qubool nahin kar sakte. Yani tujh par hamari janib se yeh farz nahin ke khwah-makhwah har har shakhs musalman ho hi jaye, hidayat tere qabze ki cheez nahin. Jo haq ki taraf kaan hi na lagaye, jo seedhi raah ki taraf aankh hi na uthaye, jo behke aur usi mein khush rahe, tujhe unki babat kyun itna khayal hai?

Tujh par zaroori kaam sirf tabligh karna hai, hidayat-o-zalalat hamare haath ki cheezein hain. Aadil hain hum, Hakeem hain hum, jo chahenge karenge, tum tang-dil na ho jaya karo. Phir farmata hai ke agarche hum tujhe yahan se le jayen, phir bhi hum in zalimon se badla liye baghair toh rahenge nahin. Agar hum tujhe teri aankhon se woh dikha den jis ka wada hum ne in se kiya hai, toh hum is se aajiz nahin. Gharz is tarah aur is tarah dono suraton mein kuffar par azab toh aayega hi, lekin phir woh surat pasand ki gayi jis mein paighambar ki izzat zyada thi. Yani Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko faut na kiya jab tak ke aap ke dushmanon ko maghloob na kar diya, aap ki aankhein thandi na kar dein, aap in ki janon aur malon aur malkiyaton ke malik na ban gaye. Yeh toh hai tafsir Hazrat Suddi waghera ki, lekin Hazrat Qatada farmate hain Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya se utha liye gaye aur inteqam baqi reh gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko aap ki zindagi mein ummat mein woh mamlaat na dikhaye jo aap ki na-pasandida thay, bajuz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aur tamam ambiya ke samne un ki ummaton par azab aaye. Hum se yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke jab se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom kara diya gaya ke aap ki ummat par kya kya wabaal aayenge, us waqt se le kar wisal ke waqt tak kabhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khul-khula kar hanste hue dekhe nahin gaye. Hazrat Hasan se bhi isi tarah ki riwayat hai. Ek hadith mein hai: Sitare aasman ke bachao ka sabab hain, jab sitare jhad jayenge toh aasman par musibat aa jayegi. Main apne ashab ka zariya-e-amn hoon, mere jane ke baad mere ashab par woh aa jayega jis ka yeh wada diye jate hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke jo Quran tujh par nazil kiya gaya hai, jo sarasar haq-o-sidq hai, jo haqaniyat ki seedhi aur saaf raah ki rahnumai karta hai, toh ise mazbooti ke sath liye reh. Yehi Jannat-e-Naeem aur Raah-e-Mustaqeem ka rehbar hai. Is par chalne wala, is ke ahkaam ko thamne wala behak aur bhatak nahin sakta. Yeh tere liye aur teri qoum ke liye zikr hai, yani sharaf aur buzurgi hai. Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Yeh amr (yani khilafat-o-imamat) Quraish mein hi rahega, jo in se jhagdega aur chheene ga use Allah Ta'ala oondhe munh girayega jab tak deen ko qaim rakhein. Is liye bhi aap ki sharafat-e-qoumi is mein hai ke yeh Quran aap hi ki zaban mein utra hai. Lughat-e-Quraish mein hi nazil hua hai, toh zahir hai ke sab se zyada ise yehi samjhenge. Inhein laiq hai ke sab se zyada mazbooti ke sath amal bhi inhi ka is par rahe, bilkhusoos is mein badi bhari buzurgi hai un Muhajireen-e-Kiram ki jinhon ne awwal-awwal sabqat kar ke Islam qabool kiya aur hijrat mein bhi sab se pesh-pesh rahe aur jo in ke qadam-ba-qadam chale. Zikr ke ma'ani nasihat, na hone ke ma'ani mein nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laqad anzalna ilaikum kitaban feehi zikrukum, afala ta'qiloon) (21. Al-Anbiya: 10), yani bil-yaqeen hum ne tumhari taraf kitab nazil farmayi jis mein tumhare liye nasihat hai, kya pas tum aql nahin rakhte?

Aur aayat mein hai (Wa-anzir 'ashiratakal-aqrabin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 214) yani apne khandani qarabat-daron ko hoshiyar kar de. Garz nasihat-e-Qurani risalat-e-Nabawi aam hai, kunbay walon ko, qoum ko aur duniya ke kul logon ko shamil hai. Phir farmata hai tum se anqareeb sawal hoga ke kahan tak is Kalam-e-Allah Sharif par amal kiya aur kahan tak ise mana? Tamam rasoolon ne apni apni qoum ko wahi dawat di jo ae Aakhir-uz-Zaman Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Aap apni ummat ko de rahe hain. Kul ambiya ke dawat namon ka khulasa sirf is qadar hai ke unhon ne tawheed phailayi aur shirk ko khatam kiya, jaise khud Quran mein hai ke hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat na karo. Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ki qirat mein yeh aayat is tarah hai (Was-al-alladhina arsalna ilayhim qablaka rusulana). Pas yeh misl-e-tafsir ke hai na tilawat ke, Wallahu A'lam. To matlab yeh hua ke un se daryaft kar le jin mein tujh se pehle hum apne aur rasoolon ko bhej chuke hain. Abdur Rahman (R.H) farmate hain nabiyon se pooch le, yani Meraj wali raat ko jab ke ambiya aap ke samne jama thay, ke har nabi tawheed sikhane aur shirk mitane ki hi taleem le kar hamari janib se mab'oos hota raha.

Fir'aun ke da'we: Fir'aun ki sarkashi aur khud-beeni bayan ho rahi hai ke us ne apni qoum ko jama kar ke un mein badi baatein haankne laga aur kaha kya main tanha mulk-e-Misr ka badshah nahin hoon? Kya mere baghaat aur mehalat mein nehrein jaari nahin? Kya tum meri azmat-o-saltanat ko dekh nahin rahe? Phir Musa (A.S) aur us ke sathiyon ko dekho jo fuqra aur zu'afa hain. Kalam-e-Pak mein aur jagah hai us ne jama kar ke sab se kaha main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon jis par Allah Ta'ala ne use yahan ke aur wahan ke azabon mein giraftar kiya. (Am) ma'ani mein (bal) ke hai. Ba'az qariyon ki qira'at (ama ana) bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain agar yeh qira'at sahih ho jaye to ma'ani to bilkul wazeh aur saaf ho jate hain lekin yeh qira'at tamam shehron ki qira'at ke khilaf hai, sab ki qira'at (am) istifham ki hai. Hasil yeh hai ke Fir'aun mal'oon apne aap ko Hazrat Kaleemullah (A.S) se behtar-o-bartar bana raha hai aur yeh darasal is mal'oon ka jhoot hai. (Maheen) ke ma'ani haqeer, za'eef, be-maal, be-shaan. Phir kehta hai Musa (A.S) to saaf bolna bhi nahin janta, us ka kalam faseeh nahin, woh apna ma-fi-zameer ada nahin kar sakta. Ba'az kehte hain bachpan mein aap ne apne munh mein aag ka angara rakh liya tha jis ka asar zaban par baqi reh gaya tha. Yeh bhi Fir'aun ka makr, jhoot aur dajal hai. Hazrat Musa (A.S) saaf go, sahih kalam karne wale, zi-izzat, ba-ra'ab-o-waqar thay. Lekin chunke mal'oon apni kufr ki aankh se Nabi-e-Allah ko dekhta tha is liye use yahi nazar aata tha. Haqeeqatan zaleel-o-ghabi tha. Go Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki zaban mein ba-wajah us angare ke jise bachpan mein munh mein rakh liya tha kuch luknat thi lekin aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua mangi aur aap ki zaban ki girah khul gayi taake aap logon ko ba-aasani apna mudda samjha sakein. Aur agar maan liya jaye ke taham kuch baqi reh gayi thi kyunke dua-e-Kaleem mein itna hi tha ke meri zaban ki is qadar girah khul jaye ke log meri baat samajh lein. To yeh bhi koi aib ki baat nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne jis kisi ko jaisa bana diya woh waisa hi hai, is mein aib ki kaunsi baat hai? Darasal Fir'aun ek kalam bana kar, ek musawwada ghad kar apni jahil ra'aya ko bhadkana aur behkana chahta tha, dekhiye woh aage chal kar kehta hai ke kyun ji is par aasman se sone ke kangan kyun nahin baraste? Maaldari to ise itni honi chahiye ke hath sone se pur hon lekin yeh mehez muflis hai. Acha yeh bhi nahin to Allah is ke sath farishte hi kar deta jo kam-az-kam hamein bawar kara dete ke yeh Allah ke Nabi hain. Garz hazar jatan kar ke logon ko bewaqoof bana liya aur unhein apna hum-khayal aur hum-sukhan kar liya. Yeh khud fasiq-o-fajir thay, fisq-o-fujoor ki pukar par foran reejh gaye. Pas jab un ka paimana chhalak gaya aur unhon ne dil khol kar Rabb ki nafarmani ki aur Rabb ko khoob naraz kar diya to phir Allah ka kora un ki peeth par barsa aur agle pichle sare kartoot pakad liye gaye. Yahan ek sath pani mein gharq kar diye gaye, wahan jahannam mein jalte jhulaste rahenge.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jab kisi insaan ko Allah duniya deta chala jaye aur woh Allah ki nafarmaniyon par jama hua ho toh samajh lo ke Allah ne use dheel de rakhi hai, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke samne jab achanak maut ka zikr aaya toh farmaya imandaar par toh yeh takhfeef hai aur kaafir par hasrat hai. Phir aap ne isi aayat ko parh kar sunaya. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) farmate hain inteqam ghaflat ke sath hai. Phir Allah Subhanah-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke hum ne unhein namuna bana diya ke un ke se kaam karne wale un ke anjaam ko dekh lein aur yeh misaal yani ba'is-e-ibrat ban jaye ke un ke baad aane wale un ke waqiyat par ghaur karein aur apna bachao dhoondein. Hazrat Musa (A.S) saaf go, sahih kalam karne wale, zi-izzat, ba-ra'ab-o-waqar thay. Lekin chunke mal'oon apni kufr ki aankh se Nabi-e-Allah ko dekhta tha is liye use yahi nazar aata tha. Haqeeqatan zaleel-o-ghabi tha. Go Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki zaban mein ba-wajah us angare ke jise bachpan mein munh mein rakh liya tha kuch luknat thi lekin aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua mangi aur aap ki zaban ki girah khul gayi taake aap logon ko ba-aasani apna mudda samjha sakein. Aur agar maan liya jaye ke taham kuch baqi reh gayi thi kyunke dua-e-Kaleem mein itna hi tha ke meri zaban ki is qadar girah khul jaye ke log meri baat samajh lein. To yeh bhi koi aib ki baat nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne jis kisi ko jaisa bana diya woh waisa hi hai, is mein aib ki kaunsi baat hai? Darasal Fir'aun ek kalam bana kar, ek musawwada ghad kar apni jahil ra'aya ko bhadkana aur behkana chahta tha, dekhiye woh aage chal kar kehta hai ke kyun ji is par aasman se sone ke kangan kyun nahin baraste? Maaldari to ise itni honi chahiye ke hath sone se pur hon lekin yeh mehez muflis hai. Acha yeh bhi nahin to Allah is ke sath farishte hi kar deta jo kam-az-kam hamein bawar kara dete ke yeh Allah ke Nabi hain. Garz hazar jatan kar ke logon ko bewaqoof bana liya aur unhein apna hum-khayal aur hum-sukhan kar liya. Yeh khud fasiq-o-fajir thay, fisq-o-fujoor ki pukar par foran reejh gaye. Pas jab un ka paimana chhalak gaya aur unhon ne dil khol kar Rabb ki nafarmani ki aur Rabb ko khoob naraz kar diya to phir Allah ka kora un ki peeth par barsa aur agle pichle sare kartoot pakad liye gaye. Yahan ek sath pani mein gharq kar diye gaye, wahan jahannam mein jalte jhulaste rahenge.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jab kisi insaan ko Allah duniya deta chala jaye aur woh Allah ki nafarmaniyon par jama hua ho toh samajh lo ke Allah ne use dheel de rakhi hai, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ke samne jab achanak maut ka zikr aaya toh farmaya imandaar par toh yeh takhfeef hai aur kaafir par hasrat hai. Phir aap ne isi aayat ko parh kar sunaya. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) farmate hain inteqam ghaflat ke sath hai. Phir Allah Subhanah-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke hum ne unhein namuna bana diya ke un ke se kaam karne wale un ke anjaam ko dekh lein aur yeh misaal yani ba'is-e-ibrat ban jaye ke un ke baad aane wale un ke waqiyat par ghaur karein aur apna bachao dhoondein. (Wallahu Subhanah-o-Ta'ala Al-Muwaffiq lis-Sawab wa ilaihil Marji'u wal Ma'ab)

Fir'aun ke da'we: Fir'aun ki sarkashi aur khud-beeni bayan ho rahi hai ke us ne apni qoum ko jama kar ke un mein badi baatein haankne laga aur kaha kya main tanha mulk-e-Misr ka badshah nahin hoon? Kya mere baghaat aur mehalat mein nehrein jaari nahin? Kya tum meri azmat-o-saltanat ko dekh nahin rahe? Phir Musa (A.S) aur us ke sathiyon ko dekho jo fuqra aur zu'afa hain. Kalam-e-Pak mein aur jagah hai us ne jama kar ke sab se kaha main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon jis par Allah Ta'ala ne use yahan ke aur wahan ke azabon mein giraftar kiya. (Am) ma'ani mein (bal) ke hai. Ba'az qariyon ki qira'at (ama ana) bhi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain agar yeh qira'at sahih ho jaye to ma'ani to bilkul wazeh aur saaf ho jate hain lekin yeh qira'at tamam shehron ki qira'at ke khilaf hai, sab ki qira'at (am) istifham ki hai. Qayamat ke qareeb nuzool-e-Isa A.S. (Yassiddun) ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Ikrama R.H aur Zahhak R.H ne kiye hain ke woh hansne lage yani is se unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua. Qatada R.H farmate hain ghabra kar bol pade. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H ka qaul hai munh pherne lage. Is ki wajah jo Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne apni Seerat mein bayan ki hai woh yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Waleed bin Mughira waghera Qurayshiyon ke paas tashreef farma thay ke Nadr bin Haris aa gaya aur Aap ﷺ se kuch baatein karne laga jis mein woh lajawab ho gaya. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98), aayaton tak padh kar sunayin yani tum aur tumhare mabood sab jahannam mein jhonk diye jaoge. Phir Huzoor ﷺ wahan se chale gaye. Thodi hi der mein Abdullah bin Zubayri Tamimi aaya to Waleed bin Mughira ne us se kaha Nadr bin Haris to Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib se haar gaya aur bil-aakhir Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib hamein aur hamare maboodon ko jahannam ka indhan kehte hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne apne maboodon ka jahannami hona Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani sun kar kaha ke phir aap Ibn-e-Maryam ki nisbat kya kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Ab koi jawab un ke paas na raha toh kehne lage wallah yeh toh chahte hain ke jis tarah Isaiyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah maan liya hai hum bhi unhein Rabb maan lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh toh sirf bakwas hai, khasiyane ho kar betuki baatein karne lage hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke Quran mein ek aayat hai mujh se kisi ne us ki tafseer nahin poochhi. Main nahin jaanta ke kya har ek use jaanta hai ya na jaan kar phir bhi jaanne ki koshish nahin karte? Phir aur baatein bayan farmate rahe yahan tak ke majlis khatam hui aur aap chale gaye. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Is par Ibn-e-Aqeel Ansari ke maula Abu Yahya ne kaha ke achha kal subah jab tashreef layenge toh main pooch loonga. Dusre din jo aaye toh main ne un ki kal ki baat dohrai aur un se daryaft kiya ke woh kaunsi aayat hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan suno! Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Quraish se farmaya koi aisa nahin jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaati ho aur us mein khair ho. Is par Quraish ne kaha kya Isai Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ibadat nahin karte? Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Matlab yeh hai ke hamare mabood Muhammad (ﷺ) se behtareen hain, yeh toh apne aap ko pujwana chahte hain, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (am haza) hai. Allah farmata hai yeh un ka munazra nahin balki mujadala aur mukabira hai yani bedaleel jhagda aur bewajah hujjat bazi hai, khud yeh jaante hain ke na yeh matlab hai na hamara yeh aitraz us par warid hota hai. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai. Is ke baad jo farmaya hai ke woh Qayamat ki nishani hai, is ka matlab jo Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ne bayan kiya hai woh kuch theek nahin. Aur is se bhi zyada door ki baat yeh hai ke ba-qaul Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja aaid hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) par. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) Qayamat ki ek nishani hain, is liye ke upar se hi Aap (A.S) ka bayan chala aa raha hai aur yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke murad yahan Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle ka nazil hona hai, jaise ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (وَاِنْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهٖ ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani un ki maut se pehle ek-ek Ahl-e-Kitab un par iman layega, yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maut se pehle Qayamat ke din yeh un par gawah honge. Is matlab ki poori wazahat isi aayat ki dusri qiraat se hoti hai jis mein hai (وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِ ۭ ھٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مّسْتَقِيْمٌ 61؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 61) yani Janab Roohullah (A.S) Qayamat ke qaim hone ka nishan aur alamat hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh nishan hain Qayamat ke liye Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle aana. Isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se aur yahi marwi hai Abul Aaliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatada (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) waghera se, Rahimahumullah. Aur mutawatir ahadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khabar di hai ke Qayamat ke din se pehle Hazrat Isa (A.S) Imam-e-Aadil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ho kar nazil honge.

Pas tum Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni jaano is mein shak-o-shuba na karo aur jo khabrein tumhein de raha hoon is mein meri tabedari karo, yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Kahin aisa na ho ke Shaitan jo tumhara khula dushman hai tumhein sahih raah se aur meri wajib itteba se rok de. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha tha ke main hikmat yani nabuwwat le kar tumhare paas aaya hoon aur deeni umoor mein jo ikhtilafat tum ne daal rakhe hain, main is mein jo haq hai use zahir karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yahi farmate hain aur yahi qaul behtar aur pukhta hai. Phir Imam sahab ne un logon ke qaul ki tardeed ki hai jo kehte hain ke 'ba'z' ka lafz yahan par 'kul' ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ki daleel mein ba'eed shayar ka ek sher pesh karte hain. Lekin wahan bhi 'ba'z' se murad qail ka khud apna nafs hai na ke sab nafs. Imam sahab ne sher ka jo matlab bayan kiya hai yeh bhi mumkin hai. Phir farmaya jo main tumhein hukum deta hoon is mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, us se darte raho aur meri itaat-guzari karo, jo laya hoon use maano, yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur khud main us ke ghulam hain, us ke mohtaj hain, us ke dar ke faqeer hain, us ki ibadat hum sab par farz hai, woh Wahid-o-La-Shareek hai. Bas yahi Tauheed ki raah, Raah-e-Mustaqeem hai. Ab log aapas mein mutafarriq ho gaye, ba'z to Kalimatullah ko Allah ka banda aur Rasool hi kehte the aur yahi haq wali jamaat thi aur ba'z ne un ki nisbat da'wa kiya ke woh Allah ke farzand hain aur ba'z ne kaha aap hi Allah hain. Allah Ta'ala in dono da'won se paak hai aur buland-o-bartar hai. Isi liye irshad farmata hai ke in zalimon ke liye kharabi hai, Qayamat wale din unhein alamnaak azaab aur dardnaak sazayein hongi.

Qayamat ke qareeb nuzool-e-Isa A.S. (Yassiddun) ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Ikrama R.H aur Zahhak R.H ne kiye hain ke woh hansne lage yani is se unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua. Qatada R.H farmate hain ghabra kar bol pade. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H ka qaul hai munh pherne lage. Is ki wajah jo Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne apni Seerat mein bayan ki hai woh yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Waleed bin Mughira waghera Qurayshiyon ke paas tashreef farma thay ke Nadr bin Haris aa gaya aur Aap ﷺ se kuch baatein karne laga jis mein woh lajawab ho gaya. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98), aayaton tak padh kar sunayin yani tum aur tumhare mabood sab jahannam mein jhonk diye jaoge. Phir Huzoor ﷺ wahan se chale gaye. Thodi hi der mein Abdullah bin Zubayri Tamimi aaya to Waleed bin Mughira ne us se kaha Nadr bin Haris to Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib se haar gaya aur bil-aakhir Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib hamein aur hamare maboodon ko jahannam ka indhan kehte hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne apne maboodon ka jahannami hona Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani sun kar kaha ke phir aap Ibn-e-Maryam ki nisbat kya kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Ab koi jawab un ke paas na raha toh kehne lage wallah yeh toh chahte hain ke jis tarah Isaiyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah maan liya hai hum bhi unhein Rabb maan lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh toh sirf bakwas hai, khasiyane ho kar betuki baatein karne lage hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke Quran mein ek aayat hai mujh se kisi ne us ki tafseer nahin poochhi. Main nahin jaanta ke kya har ek use jaanta hai ya na jaan kar phir bhi jaanne ki koshish nahin karte? Phir aur baatein bayan farmate rahe yahan tak ke majlis khatam hui aur aap chale gaye. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Is par Ibn-e-Aqeel Ansari ke maula Abu Yahya ne kaha ke achha kal subah jab tashreef layenge toh main pooch loonga. Dusre din jo aaye toh main ne un ki kal ki baat dohrai aur un se daryaft kiya ke woh kaunsi aayat hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan suno! Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Quraish se farmaya koi aisa nahin jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaati ho aur us mein khair ho. Is par Quraish ne kaha kya Isai Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ibadat nahin karte? Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Matlab yeh hai ke hamare mabood Muhammad (ﷺ) se behtareen hain, yeh toh apne aap ko pujwana chahte hain, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (am haza) hai. Allah farmata hai yeh un ka munazra nahin balki mujadala aur mukabira hai yani bedaleel jhagda aur bewajah hujjat bazi hai, khud yeh jaante hain ke na yeh matlab hai na hamara yeh aitraz us par warid hota hai. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai.
