Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Matlab yeh hai ke hamare mabood Muhammad (ﷺ) se behtareen hain, yeh toh apne aap ko pujwana chahte hain, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (am haza) hai. Allah farmata hai yeh un ka munazra nahin balki mujadala aur mukabira hai yani bedaleel jhagda aur bewajah hujjat bazi hai, khud yeh jaante hain ke na yeh matlab hai na hamara yeh aitraz us par warid hota hai. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai. Is ke baad jo farmaya hai ke woh Qayamat ki nishani hai, is ka matlab jo Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ne bayan kiya hai woh kuch theek nahin. Aur is se bhi zyada door ki baat yeh hai ke ba-qaul Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja aaid hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) par. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) Qayamat ki ek nishani hain, is liye ke upar se hi Aap (A.S) ka bayan chala aa raha hai aur yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke murad yahan Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle ka nazil hona hai, jaise ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (وَاِنْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهٖ ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani un ki maut se pehle ek-ek Ahl-e-Kitab un par iman layega, yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maut se pehle Qayamat ke din yeh un par gawah honge. Is matlab ki poori wazahat isi aayat ki dusri qiraat se hoti hai jis mein hai (وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِ ۭ ھٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مّسْتَقِيْمٌ 61؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 61) yani Janab Roohullah (A.S) Qayamat ke qaim hone ka nishan aur alamat hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh nishan hain Qayamat ke liye Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle aana. Isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se aur yahi marwi hai Abul Aaliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatada (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) waghera se, Rahimahumullah. Aur mutawatir ahadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khabar di hai ke Qayamat ke din se pehle Hazrat Isa (A.S) Imam-e-Aadil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ho kar nazil honge.

Pas tum Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni jaano is mein shak-o-shuba na karo aur jo khabrein tumhein de raha hoon is mein meri tabedari karo, yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Kahin aisa na ho ke Shaitan jo tumhara khula dushman hai tumhein sahih raah se aur meri wajib itteba se rok de. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha tha ke main hikmat yani nabuwwat le kar tumhare paas aaya hoon aur deeni umoor mein jo ikhtilafat tum ne daal rakhe hain, main is mein jo haq hai use zahir karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yahi farmate hain aur yahi qaul behtar aur pukhta hai. Phir Imam sahab ne un logon ke qaul ki tardeed ki hai jo kehte hain ke 'ba'z' ka lafz yahan par 'kul' ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ki daleel mein ba'eed shayar ka ek sher pesh karte hain. Lekin wahan bhi 'ba'z' se murad qail ka khud apna nafs hai na ke sab nafs. Imam sahab ne sher ka jo matlab bayan kiya hai yeh bhi mumkin hai. Phir farmaya jo main tumhein hukum deta hoon is mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, us se darte raho aur meri itaat-guzari karo, jo laya hoon use maano, yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur khud main us ke ghulam hain, us ke mohtaj hain, us ke dar ke faqeer hain, us ki ibadat hum sab par farz hai, woh Wahid-o-La-Shareek hai. Bas yahi Tauheed ki raah, Raah-e-Mustaqeem hai. Ab log aapas mein mutafarriq ho gaye, ba'z to Kalimatullah ko Allah ka banda aur Rasool hi kehte the aur yahi haq wali jamaat thi aur ba'z ne un ki nisbat da'wa kiya ke woh Allah ke farzand hain aur ba'z ne kaha aap hi Allah hain. Allah Ta'ala in dono da'won se paak hai aur buland-o-bartar hai. Isi liye irshad farmata hai ke in zalimon ke liye kharabi hai, Qayamat wale din unhein alamnaak azaab aur dardnaak sazayein hongi.

Qayamat ke qareeb nuzool-e-Isa A.S. (Yassiddun) ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Ikrama R.H aur Zahhak R.H ne kiye hain ke woh hansne lage yani is se unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua. Qatada R.H farmate hain ghabra kar bol pade. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H ka qaul hai munh pherne lage. Is ki wajah jo Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne apni Seerat mein bayan ki hai woh yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Waleed bin Mughira waghera Qurayshiyon ke paas tashreef farma thay ke Nadr bin Haris aa gaya aur Aap ﷺ se kuch baatein karne laga jis mein woh lajawab ho gaya. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98), aayaton tak padh kar sunayin yani tum aur tumhare mabood sab jahannam mein jhonk diye jaoge. Phir Huzoor ﷺ wahan se chale gaye. Thodi hi der mein Abdullah bin Zubayri Tamimi aaya to Waleed bin Mughira ne us se kaha Nadr bin Haris to Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib se haar gaya aur bil-aakhir Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib hamein aur hamare maboodon ko jahannam ka indhan kehte hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne apne maboodon ka jahannami hona Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani sun kar kaha ke phir aap Ibn-e-Maryam ki nisbat kya kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Ab koi jawab un ke paas na raha toh kehne lage wallah yeh toh chahte hain ke jis tarah Isaiyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah maan liya hai hum bhi unhein Rabb maan lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh toh sirf bakwas hai, khasiyane ho kar betuki baatein karne lage hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke Quran mein ek aayat hai mujh se kisi ne us ki tafseer nahin poochhi. Main nahin jaanta ke kya har ek use jaanta hai ya na jaan kar phir bhi jaanne ki koshish nahin karte? Phir aur baatein bayan farmate rahe yahan tak ke majlis khatam hui aur aap chale gaye. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Is par Ibn-e-Aqeel Ansari ke maula Abu Yahya ne kaha ke achha kal subah jab tashreef layenge toh main pooch loonga. Dusre din jo aaye toh main ne un ki kal ki baat dohrai aur un se daryaft kiya ke woh kaunsi aayat hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan suno! Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Quraish se farmaya koi aisa nahin jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaati ho aur us mein khair ho. Is par Quraish ne kaha kya Isai Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ibadat nahin karte? Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Matlab yeh hai ke hamare mabood Muhammad (ﷺ) se behtareen hain, yeh toh apne aap ko pujwana chahte hain, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (am haza) hai. Allah farmata hai yeh un ka munazra nahin balki mujadala aur mukabira hai yani bedaleel jhagda aur bewajah hujjat bazi hai, khud yeh jaante hain ke na yeh matlab hai na hamara yeh aitraz us par warid hota hai. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai. Is ke baad jo farmaya hai ke woh Qayamat ki nishani hai, is ka matlab jo Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ne bayan kiya hai woh kuch theek nahin. Aur is se bhi zyada door ki baat yeh hai ke ba-qaul Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja aaid hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) par. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) Qayamat ki ek nishani hain, is liye ke upar se hi Aap (A.S) ka bayan chala aa raha hai aur yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke murad yahan Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle ka nazil hona hai, jaise ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (وَاِنْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهٖ ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani un ki maut se pehle ek-ek Ahl-e-Kitab un par iman layega, yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maut se pehle Qayamat ke din yeh un par gawah honge. Is matlab ki poori wazahat isi aayat ki dusri qiraat se hoti hai jis mein hai (وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِ ۭ ھٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مّسْتَقِيْمٌ 61؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 61) yani Janab Roohullah (A.S) Qayamat ke qaim hone ka nishan aur alamat hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh nishan hain Qayamat ke liye Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle aana. Isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se aur yahi marwi hai Abul Aaliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatada (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) waghera se, Rahimahumullah. Aur mutawatir ahadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khabar di hai ke Qayamat ke din se pehle Hazrat Isa (A.S) Imam-e-Aadil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ho kar nazil honge.

Pas tum Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni jaano is mein shak-o-shuba na karo aur jo khabrein tumhein de raha hoon is mein meri tabedari karo, yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Kahin aisa na ho ke Shaitan jo tumhara khula dushman hai tumhein sahih raah se aur meri wajib itteba se rok de. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha tha ke main hikmat yani nabuwwat le kar tumhare paas aaya hoon aur deeni umoor mein jo ikhtilafat tum ne daal rakhe hain, main is mein jo haq hai use zahir karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yahi farmate hain aur yahi qaul behtar aur pukhta hai. Phir Imam sahab ne un logon ke qaul ki tardeed ki hai jo kehte hain ke 'ba'z' ka lafz yahan par 'kul' ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ki daleel mein ba'eed shayar ka ek sher pesh karte hain. Lekin wahan bhi 'ba'z' se murad qail ka khud apna nafs hai na ke sab nafs. Imam sahab ne sher ka jo matlab bayan kiya hai yeh bhi mumkin hai. Phir farmaya jo main tumhein hukum deta hoon is mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, us se darte raho aur meri itaat-guzari karo, jo laya hoon use maano, yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur khud main us ke ghulam hain, us ke mohtaj hain, us ke dar ke faqeer hain, us ki ibadat hum sab par farz hai, woh Wahid-o-La-Shareek hai. Bas yahi Tauheed ki raah, Raah-e-Mustaqeem hai. Ab log aapas mein mutafarriq ho gaye, ba'z to Kalimatullah ko Allah ka banda aur Rasool hi kehte the aur yahi haq wali jamaat thi aur ba'z ne un ki nisbat da'wa kiya ke woh Allah ke farzand hain aur ba'z ne kaha aap hi Allah hain. Allah Ta'ala in dono da'won se paak hai aur buland-o-bartar hai. Isi liye irshad farmata hai ke in zalimon ke liye kharabi hai, Qayamat wale din unhein alamnaak azaab aur dardnaak sazayein hongi.

Isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se aur yahi marwi hai Abul Aaliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatada (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) waghera se, Rahimahumullah. Aur mutawatir ahadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khabar di hai ke Qayamat ke din se pehle Hazrat Isa (A.S) Imam-e-Aadil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ho kar nazil honge.

Pas tum Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni jaano is mein shak-o-shuba na karo aur jo khabrein tumhein de raha hoon is mein meri tabedari karo, yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Kahin aisa na ho ke Shaitan jo tumhara khula dushman hai tumhein sahih raah se aur meri wajib itteba se rok de. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha tha ke main hikmat yani nabuwwat le kar tumhare paas aaya hoon aur deeni umoor mein jo ikhtilafat tum ne daal rakhe hain, main is mein jo haq hai use zahir karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yahi farmate hain aur yahi qaul behtar aur pukhta hai. Phir Imam sahab ne un logon ke qaul ki tardeed ki hai jo kehte hain ke 'ba'z' ka lafz yahan par 'kul' ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ki daleel mein ba'eed shayar ka ek sher pesh karte hain. Lekin wahan bhi 'ba'z' se murad qail ka khud apna nafs hai na ke sab nafs. Imam sahab ne sher ka jo matlab bayan kiya hai yeh bhi mumkin hai. Phir farmaya jo main tumhein hukum deta hoon is mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, us se darte raho aur meri itaat-guzari karo, jo laya hoon use maano, yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur khud main us ke ghulam hain, us ke mohtaj hain, us ke dar ke faqeer hain, us ki ibadat hum sab par farz hai, woh Wahid-o-La-Shareek hai. Bas yahi Tauheed ki raah, Raah-e-Mustaqeem hai. Ab log aapas mein mutafarriq ho gaye, ba'z to Kalimatullah ko Allah ka banda aur Rasool hi kehte the aur yahi haq wali jamaat thi aur ba'z ne un ki nisbat da'wa kiya ke woh Allah ke farzand hain aur ba'z ne kaha aap hi Allah hain. Allah Ta'ala in dono da'won se paak hai aur buland-o-bartar hai. Isi liye irshad farmata hai ke in zalimon ke liye kharabi hai, Qayamat wale din unhein alamnaak azaab aur dardnaak sazayein hongi.

Qayamat ke qareeb nuzool-e-Isa A.S. (Yassiddun) ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Ikrama R.H aur Zahhak R.H ne kiye hain ke woh hansne lage yani is se unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua. Qatada R.H farmate hain ghabra kar bol pade. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H ka qaul hai munh pherne lage. Is ki wajah jo Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne apni Seerat mein bayan ki hai woh yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Waleed bin Mughira waghera Qurayshiyon ke paas tashreef farma thay ke Nadr bin Haris aa gaya aur Aap ﷺ se kuch baatein karne laga jis mein woh lajawab ho gaya. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98), aayaton tak padh kar sunayin yani tum aur tumhare mabood sab jahannam mein jhonk diye jaoge. Phir Huzoor ﷺ wahan se chale gaye. Thodi hi der mein Abdullah bin Zubayri Tamimi aaya to Waleed bin Mughira ne us se kaha Nadr bin Haris to Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib se haar gaya aur bil-aakhir Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib hamein aur hamare maboodon ko jahannam ka indhan kehte hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne apne maboodon ka jahannami hona Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani sun kar kaha ke phir aap Ibn-e-Maryam ki nisbat kya kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Ab koi jawab un ke paas na raha toh kehne lage wallah yeh toh chahte hain ke jis tarah Isaiyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah maan liya hai hum bhi unhein Rabb maan lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh toh sirf bakwas hai, khasiyane ho kar betuki baatein karne lage hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke Quran mein ek aayat hai mujh se kisi ne us ki tafseer nahin poochhi. Main nahin jaanta ke kya har ek use jaanta hai ya na jaan kar phir bhi jaanne ki koshish nahin karte? Phir aur baatein bayan farmate rahe yahan tak ke majlis khatam hui aur aap chale gaye. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Is par Ibn-e-Aqeel Ansari ke maula Abu Yahya ne kaha ke achha kal subah jab tashreef layenge toh main pooch loonga. Dusre din jo aaye toh main ne un ki kal ki baat dohrai aur un se daryaft kiya ke woh kaunsi aayat hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan suno! Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Quraish se farmaya koi aisa nahin jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaati ho aur us mein khair ho. Is par Quraish ne kaha kya Isai Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ibadat nahin karte? Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Matlab yeh hai ke hamare mabood Muhammad (ﷺ) se behtareen hain, yeh toh apne aap ko pujwana chahte hain, Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (am haza) hai. Allah farmata hai yeh un ka munazra nahin balki mujadala aur mukabira hai yani bedaleel jhagda aur bewajah hujjat bazi hai, khud yeh jaante hain ke na yeh matlab hai na hamara yeh aitraz us par warid hota hai. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai. Is ke baad jo farmaya hai ke woh Qayamat ki nishani hai, is ka matlab jo Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ne bayan kiya hai woh kuch theek nahin. Aur is se bhi zyada door ki baat yeh hai ke ba-qaul Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja aaid hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) par. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) Qayamat ki ek nishani hain, is liye ke upar se hi Aap (A.S) ka bayan chala aa raha hai aur yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke murad yahan Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle ka nazil hona hai, jaise ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (وَاِنْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهٖ ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani un ki maut se pehle ek-ek Ahl-e-Kitab un par iman layega, yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maut se pehle Qayamat ke din yeh un par gawah honge. Is liye awwalan toh aayat mein lafz (ma) hai jo ghair-e-zawi-ul-uqool ke liye hai, dusre yeh ke aayat mein khitab kuffar-e-Quraish se hai jo asnaam-o-andaad yani buton aur pattharon ko poojte thay, woh Maseeh ke pujari na thay jo yeh aitraz bar-mahal mana jaye, pas yeh sirf jadal hai yani woh baat kehte hain jis ke ghair-e-sahih hone ko un ke apne dil ko bhi yaqeen hai.

Tirmidhi waghera mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ) hai ke koi qoum us waqt tak halak nahin hoti jab tak be-daleel hujjat-bazi us mein na aa jaye. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein is hadith ke shuru mein yeh bhi hai ke har ummat ki gumrahi ki pehli baat apne Nabi ke baad taqdeer ka inkar karna hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke ek baar Huzoor (ﷺ) sahaba ke majmay mein aaye, us waqt woh Quran ki aayaton mein behas kar rahe thay. Aap (ﷺ) sakht ghazabnak hue aur farmaya: Is tarah Allah ki Kitab ki aayaton ko ek dusri ke sath takrao nahin, yaad rakho jhagray ki isi aadat ne aglay logon ko gumrah kar diya. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat (مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۭ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ 58؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 58) ki tilawat farmayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke bandon mein se ek banday thay, jin par nabuwwat-o-risalat ka inaam-e-Bari Ta'ala hua tha aur unhein Allah ki qudrat ki nishani bana kar Bani Israel ki taraf bheja gaya tha taake woh jaan lein ke Allah jo chahe us par qadir hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke agar hum chahte to tumhare janasheen bana kar farishton ko is zameen mein abad kar dete, ya yeh ke jis tarah tum ek dusre ke janasheen hote ho, yahi baat un mein kar dete. Matlab dono suraton mein ek hi hai. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yani bajaye tumhare zameen ki abadi un se hoti hai. Is ke baad jo farmaya hai ke woh Qayamat ki nishani hai, is ka matlab jo Ibn-e-Ishaq (R.H) ne bayan kiya hai woh kuch theek nahin. Aur is se bhi zyada door ki baat yeh hai ke ba-qaul Qatada (R.H), Hazrat Hasan Basri (R.H) aur Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) kehte hain ke 'ha' ki zameer ka marja aaid hai Hazrat Isa (A.S) par. Yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) Qayamat ki ek nishani hain, is liye ke upar se hi Aap (A.S) ka bayan chala aa raha hai aur yeh bhi wazeh rahe ke murad yahan Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle ka nazil hona hai, jaise ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne farmaya aayat (وَاِنْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ اِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهٖ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهٖ ۚ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يَكُوْنُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيْدًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 159) yani un ki maut se pehle ek-ek Ahl-e-Kitab un par iman layega, yani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki maut se pehle Qayamat ke din yeh un par gawah honge. Is matlab ki poori wazahat isi aayat ki dusri qiraat se hoti hai jis mein hai (وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِ ۭ ھٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مّسْتَقِيْمٌ 61؀) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 61) yani Janab Roohullah (A.S) Qayamat ke qaim hone ka nishan aur alamat hain. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain yeh nishan hain Qayamat ke liye Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka Qayamat se pehle aana. Isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) se aur Hazrat Abbas (R.A) se aur yahi marwi hai Abul Aaliyah (R.H), Abu Malik (R.H), Ikrama (R.H), Hasan (R.H), Qatada (R.H), Zahhak (R.H) waghera se, Rahimahumullah. Aur mutawatir ahadith mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne khabar di hai ke Qayamat ke din se pehle Hazrat Isa (A.S) Imam-e-Aadil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ho kar nazil honge.

Pas tum Qayamat ka aana yaqeeni jaano is mein shak-o-shuba na karo aur jo khabrein tumhein de raha hoon is mein meri tabedari karo, yahi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem hai. Kahin aisa na ho ke Shaitan jo tumhara khula dushman hai tumhein sahih raah se aur meri wajib itteba se rok de. Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne apni qoum se kaha tha ke main hikmat yani nabuwwat le kar tumhare paas aaya hoon aur deeni umoor mein jo ikhtilafat tum ne daal rakhe hain, main is mein jo haq hai use zahir karne ke liye bheja gaya hoon. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) yahi farmate hain aur yahi qaul behtar aur pukhta hai. Phir Imam sahab ne un logon ke qaul ki tardeed ki hai jo kehte hain ke 'ba'z' ka lafz yahan par 'kul' ke ma'ani mein hai aur is ki daleel mein ba'eed shayar ka ek sher pesh karte hain. Lekin wahan bhi 'ba'z' se murad qail ka khud apna nafs hai na ke sab nafs. Imam sahab ne sher ka jo matlab bayan kiya hai yeh bhi mumkin hai. Phir farmaya jo main tumhein hukum deta hoon is mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, us se darte raho aur meri itaat-guzari karo, jo laya hoon use maano, yaqeen maano ke tum sab aur khud main us ke ghulam hain, us ke mohtaj hain, us ke dar ke faqeer hain, us ki ibadat hum sab par farz hai, woh Wahid-o-La-Shareek hai. Bas yahi Tauheed ki raah, Raah-e-Mustaqeem hai. Ab log aapas mein mutafarriq ho gaye, ba'z to Kalimatullah ko Allah ka banda aur Rasool hi kehte the aur yahi haq wali jamaat thi aur ba'z ne un ki nisbat da'wa kiya ke woh Allah ke farzand hain aur ba'z ne kaha aap hi Allah hain. Allah Ta'ala in dono da'won se paak hai aur buland-o-bartar hai. Isi liye irshad farmata hai ke in zalimon ke liye kharabi hai, Qayamat wale din unhein alamnaak azaab aur dardnaak sazayein hongi.

Qayamat ke qareeb nuzool-e-Isa A.S. (Yassiddun) ke ma'ani Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A, Mujahid R.H, Ikrama R.H aur Zahhak R.H ne kiye hain ke woh hansne lage yani is se unhein ta'ajjub maloom hua. Qatada R.H farmate hain ghabra kar bol pade. Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H ka qaul hai munh pherne lage. Is ki wajah jo Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne apni Seerat mein bayan ki hai woh yeh hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Waleed bin Mughira waghera Qurayshiyon ke paas tashreef farma thay ke Nadr bin Haris aa gaya aur Aap ﷺ se kuch baatein karne laga jis mein woh lajawab ho gaya. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (Innakum wa ma ta'buduna min dunillahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 98), aayaton tak padh kar sunayin yani tum aur tumhare mabood sab jahannam mein jhonk diye jaoge. Phir Huzoor ﷺ wahan se chale gaye. Thodi hi der mein Abdullah bin Zubayri Tamimi aaya to Waleed bin Mughira ne us se kaha Nadr bin Haris to Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib se haar gaya aur bil-aakhir Ibn-e-Abdul Muttalib hamein aur hamare maboodon ko jahannam ka indhan kehte hue chale gaye. Us ne kaha agar main hota to khud unhein lajawab kar deta, jao zara un se pucho to ke jab hum aur hamare saare mabood dozakhi hain to lazim aaya ke saare farishte aur Hazrat Uzair A.S aur Hazrat Maseeh A.S bhi jahannam mein jayenge kyunke hum farishton ko poojte hain, Yahood Hazrat Uzair A.S ki parastish karte hain, Nasrani Hazrat Isa A.S ki ibadat karte hain. Is par majlis ke kuffar bahut khush hue aur kaha haan yeh jawab bahut theek hai. Lekin jab Huzoor ﷺ tak yeh baat pahunchi to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya har woh shakhs jo ghair-ullah ki ibadat kare aur har woh shakhs jo apni ibadat apni khushi se karaye yeh dono aabid-o-mabood jahannami hain. Farishton ya nabiyon ne na apni ibadat ka hukum diya na woh is se khush. Un ke naam se darasal yeh shaitan ki ibadat karte hain, wahi unhein shirk ka hukum deta hai aur yeh baja late hain. Is par aayat (Innal-lazina sabaqat lahum minnal-husna ula'ika 'anha mub'adun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 101), nazil hui yani Hazrat Isa A.S, Hazrat Uzair A.S, aur un ke alawa jin ahbar-o-rahban ki parastish yeh log karte hain aur khud woh Allah ki ita'at par thay, shirk se bezar aur is se rokne wale thay aur un ke baad gumrahon, jahilon ne unhein mabood bana liya to woh mehez be-qasoor hain. Aur farishton ko jo mushrikeen Allah ki betiyan maan kar poojte thay un ki tardeed mein aayat (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88), se kayi aayaton tak nazil huin aur un ke is batil aqeeday ki poori tardeed kar di aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke bare mein us ne jo jawab diya tha jis par mushrikeen khush hue thay yeh aayatein utrin ke is qaul ko sunte hi ke maboodan-e-batil bhi apne aabidon ke sath jahannam mein jayenge unhon ne jhat se Hazrat Isa A.S ki zaat-e-girami ko pesh kar diya aur yeh sunte hi mare khushi ke Aap ﷺ ki qoum ke mushrik uchhal pade aur badh badh kar baatein banane lage ke hum ne daba liya.

Un se kaho ke Hazrat Isa (A.S) ne kisi se apni ya kisi aur ki parastish nahin karayi, woh toh khud barabar hamari ghulami mein lage rahe aur hum ne bhi unhein apni behtareen ne'matein ata farmayin. Un ke hathon jo mojizat duniya ko dikhaye woh Qayamat ki daleel thay. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne apne maboodon ka jahannami hona Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani sun kar kaha ke phir aap Ibn-e-Maryam ki nisbat kya kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh Allah ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. Ab koi jawab un ke paas na raha toh kehne lage wallah yeh toh chahte hain ke jis tarah Isaiyon ne Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah maan liya hai hum bhi unhein Rabb maan lein. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai yeh toh sirf bakwas hai, khasiyane ho kar betuki baatein karne lage hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ne farmaya ke Quran mein ek aayat hai mujh se kisi ne us ki tafseer nahin poochhi. Main nahin jaanta ke kya har ek use jaanta hai ya na jaan kar phir bhi jaanne ki koshish nahin karte? Phir aur baatein bayan farmate rahe yahan tak ke majlis khatam hui aur aap chale gaye. Ab hamein bada afsos hone laga ke woh aayat toh phir bhi reh gayi aur hum mein se kisi ne daryaft hi na kiya. Is par Ibn-e-Aqeel Ansari ke maula Abu Yahya ne kaha ke achha kal subah jab tashreef layenge toh main pooch loonga. Dusre din jo aaye toh main ne un ki kal ki baat dohrai aur un se daryaft kiya ke woh kaunsi aayat hai? Aap (R.A) ne farmaya haan suno! Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Quraish se farmaya koi aisa nahin jis ki ibadat Allah ke siwa ki jaati ho aur us mein khair ho. Is par Quraish ne kaha kya Isai Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki ibadat nahin karte? Aur kya aap Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka Nabi aur us ka barguzida nek banda nahin maante? Phir us ka kya matlab hua ke Allah ke siwa jis ki ibadat ki jaati hai woh khair se khali hai? Is par yeh aayatein utrin. Ke jab Isa bin Maryam ka zikr aaya toh log hansne lage. Woh Qayamat ka ilm hain yani Isa bin Maryam ka Qayamat ke din se pehle nikalna. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein bhi yeh riwayat pichhle jumle ke ilawa hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain un ke is qaul ka ke kya hamare mabood behtar hain ya woh. Jannat mein jannat ke haqdar Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke dekho toh yeh mushrik qayamat ka intezar kar rahe hain jo mehez besood hai is liye ke is ke aane ka kisi ko sahi waqt toh maloom nahin woh achanak yunhi bekhabari ki halat mein aajayegi us waqt go nadim hon lekin is se kya fayda? Yeh ise namumkin samjhe hue hain lekin woh na sirf mumkin balkay yaqeenan aane hi wali hai aur us waqt ka ya us ke baad ka koi amal kisi ko kuch nafa na de ga. Us din toh jin ki dostiyan ghair-Allah ke liye thin woh sab adawat se badal jayengi yahan jo dosti Allah ke waste thi woh baqi aur da'im rahegi. Jaise Khalil-ur-Rahman A.S ne apni qoum se farmaya tha ke tum ne buton se jo dostiyan kar rakhi hain yeh sirf duniya ke rehne tak hi hain qayamat ke din toh ek dusre ka na sirf inkar karenge balkay ek dusre par la'nat bhi bhejenge aur tumhara thikana jahannam hoga aur koi na hoga jo tumhari imdad par aaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein marvi hai ke Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu farmate hain do imandar jo aapas mein dost hote hain jab un mein se ek ka inteqal hojata hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se use jannat ki khushkhabri milti hai toh woh apne dost ko yaad karta hai aur kehta hai ae Allah! Fulan shakhs mera dili dost tha jo mujhe tere aur tere Rasool ki ita'at ka hukum deta tha, bhalai ki hidayat karta tha, burai se rokta tha aur mujhe yaqeen dilaya karta tha ke ek roz Allah se milna hai, pas ae Bari Ta'ala! Tu use rah-e-haq par sabit qadam rakh yahan tak ke use bhi tu woh dikhaye jo tu ne mujhe dikhaya hai aur us se bhi isi tarah razi hojaye jis tarah mujh se razi hua hai. Allah ki taraf se jawab milta hai tu thande kaleje chala ja, us ke liye jo kuch main ne tayyar kiya hai agar tu use dekh leta toh tu bahut hansta aur bilkul azurda na hota. Phir jab dusra dost marta hai aur un ki ruhein milti hain toh kaha jata hai ke tum aapas mein ek dusre ka ta'alluq bayan karo, pas har ek dusre se kehta hai ke yeh mera bada achha bhai tha aur nihayat nek sathi tha aur bahut behtar dost tha. Do kafir jo aapas mein ek dusre ke dost the jab un mein se ek marta hai aur jahannam ki khabar diya jata hai toh use bhi apna dost yaad aata hai aur kehta hai Bari Ta'ala! Phir farmaya ke in muttaqiyon se roz-e-Qayamat mein kaha jayega ke tum khauf-o-haras se door ho. Har tarah aman-o-chain se raho saho yeh hai tumhare iman-o-Islam ka badla. Ya'ni batin mein yaqeen-o-etiqad-e-kamil. Aur zahir mein shariat par amal. Hazrat Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Qayamat ke din jab ke log apni apni qabron se khade kiye jayenge. To sab ke sab ghabrahat aur be-chaini mein honge us waqt ek munadi nida karega ke ae mere bando! Aaj ke din na tum par khauf hai na gham to tamam ke tamam ise aam samajh kar khush ho jayenge wahin munadi kahega woh log jo dil se iman laye the aur jism se nek kaam kiye the us waqt siwaye sache pakke musalmanon ke baqi sab mayoos ho jayenge phir un se kaha jayega ke tum ne'mat-o-sa'adat ke sath Jannat mein dakhil ho jao. Surah Rum mein is ki tafsir guzar chuki hai. Charon taraf se un ke samne tarah tarah ke mulazziz muragghan khush-zaiqa marghoob khanon ki tashtariyan, rakabiyan aur piyaliyan pesh hongi aur chhalkte hue jaam hathon mein liye ghilman idhar udhar gardish kar rahe honge. Ayat (Tushtahi-ul-Anfus) aur (Tashtahi-ul-Anfus) dono qiratein hain. Yunhi unhein mazedar khushbu wale achi rangat wale man-mane khane peene milenge. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se neeche darje ka Jannati jo sab se akhir mein Jannat mein jayega us ki nigah sau saal ke raste tak jati hogi lekin barabar wahan tak use apne hi dere aur mahal sone ke zumurrad ke nazar aayenge jo tamam ke tamam qisam qisam aur rang barang ke saaz-o-saman se pur honge. Subh-o-sham sattar sattar hazar rakabiyan piyale alag alag waza ke khane se pur us ke samne rakhe jayenge jin mein se har ek us ki khwahish ke mutabiq hoga. Aur awwal se akhir tak us ki ishtaha barabar aur yaksan rahegi. Agar woh roo-e-zameen walon ki dawat kar de to sab ko kifayat ho jaye aur kuch na ghate (Abdur Razzaq). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jannat ka zikr karte hue farmaya ke Jannati ek luqma uthayega aur us ke dil mein khayal aayega ke falan qisam ka khana hota to acha hota chunancha woh niwala us ke munh mein woh cheez ban jayega jis ki us ne khwahish ki thi phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se adna martabe ke Jannati ke bala khane ki saat manzilein hongi yeh chhati manzil mein hoga aur us ke upar saatwin hogi us ke tees khadim honge jo subh-o-sham teen sau sone ke bartanon mein us ke ta'am-o-sharab pesh karenge har ek mein alag alag qisam ka ajeeb-o-ghareeb aur nihayat lazeez khana hoga awwal se akhir tak use khane ki ishtaha waisi hi rahegi. Isi tarah teen sau sone ke piyalon aur katoron aur glasson mein use peene ki cheezein di jayengi.

Sab bhi agar mere yahan kha jayen toh bhi mere khane mein kami nahin aa sakti aur us ki behtar biwiyan hoor-e-ain mein se hongi. Aur duniya ki biwiyan alag hongi. In mein se ek ek meel meel bhar ki jagah mein baithe gi, phir sath hi un se kaha jaye ga ke yeh ne'matein bhi hamesha rehne wali hain aur tum bhi yahan hamesha rahoge. Na maut aaye, na ghata aaye, na jagah badle, na takleef pohanche. Phir un par apna fazl-o-ehsan bataya jata hai ke tumhare a'maal ka badla main ne apni wasee rahmat se tumhein yeh diya hai. Kyunke koi shakhs baghair rahmat-e-Allah ke sirf apne a'maal ki bina par jannat mein nahin ja sakta. Albata jannat ke darjon mein tafawut jo hoga woh nek a'maal ke tafawut ki wajah se hoga. Aur har ek jannati bhi apni jahannam ki jagah jannat mein se dekhe ga aur Allah ka shukr karte hue kahe ga ke hum khud apne taur par rah-e-rast ke hasil karne par qadir na thay, agar Allah Ta'ala khud hamari rehnumai na karta. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain har har shakhs ki ek jagah jannat mein hai aur ek jagah jahannam mein. Pas kafir momin ki jahannam ki jagah ka waris hoga aur momin kafir ki jannat ki jagah ka waris hoga. Yehi farman-e-bari hai, is jannat ke waris tum ba-sabab apne a'maal ke banaye gaye ho. Khane peene ke zikr ke baad ab mewon aur tarkariyon ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh bhi ba-kasrat marghoob-e-tab'a unhein milengi. Jis qisam ki yeh chahein aur un ki khwahish ho. Gharz bharpoor ne'maton ke sath Rabb ke razamandi ke ghar mein hamesha rahenge, Allah hamein bhi naseeb farmaye. Ameen.

Aur har ek jannati bhi apni jahannam ki jagah jannat mein se dekhe ga aur Allah ka shukr karte hue kahe ga ke hum khud apne taur par rah-e-rast ke hasil karne par qadir na thay, agar Allah Ta'ala khud hamari rehnumai na karta. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain har har shakhs ki ek jagah jannat mein hai aur ek jagah jahannam mein. Pas kafir momin ki jahannam ki jagah ka waris hoga aur momin kafir ki jannat ki jagah ka waris hoga. Yehi farman-e-bari hai, is jannat ke waris tum ba-sabab apne a'maal ke banaye gaye ho. Khane peene ke zikr ke baad ab mewon aur tarkariyon ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh bhi ba-kasrat marghoob-e-tab'a unhein milengi. Jis qisam ki yeh chahein aur un ki khwahish ho. Gharz bharpoor ne'maton ke sath Rabb ke razamandi ke ghar mein hamesha rahenge, Allah hamein bhi naseeb farmaye. Ameen.

Jannat mein jannat ke haqdar Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke dekho toh yeh mushrik qayamat ka intezar kar rahe hain jo mehez besood hai is liye ke is ke aane ka kisi ko sahi waqt toh maloom nahin woh achanak yunhi bekhabari ki halat mein aajayegi us waqt go nadim hon lekin is se kya fayda? Yeh ise namumkin samjhe hue hain lekin woh na sirf mumkin balkay yaqeenan aane hi wali hai aur us waqt ka ya us ke baad ka koi amal kisi ko kuch nafa na de ga. Us din toh jin ki dostiyan ghair-Allah ke liye thin woh sab adawat se badal jayengi yahan jo dosti Allah ke waste thi woh baqi aur da'im rahegi. Jaise Khalil-ur-Rahman A.S ne apni qoum se farmaya tha ke tum ne buton se jo dostiyan kar rakhi hain yeh sirf duniya ke rehne tak hi hain qayamat ke din toh ek dusre ka na sirf inkar karenge balkay ek dusre par la'nat bhi bhejenge aur tumhara thikana jahannam hoga aur koi na hoga jo tumhari imdad par aaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein marvi hai ke Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu farmate hain do imandar jo aapas mein dost hote hain jab un mein se ek ka inteqal hojata hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se use jannat ki khushkhabri milti hai toh woh apne dost ko yaad karta hai aur kehta hai ae Allah! Fulan shakhs mera dili dost tha jo mujhe tere aur tere Rasool ki ita'at ka hukum deta tha, bhalai ki hidayat karta tha, burai se rokta tha aur mujhe yaqeen dilaya karta tha ke ek roz Allah se milna hai, pas ae Bari Ta'ala! Tu use rah-e-haq par sabit qadam rakh yahan tak ke use bhi tu woh dikhaye jo tu ne mujhe dikhaya hai aur us se bhi isi tarah razi hojaye jis tarah mujh se razi hua hai. Allah ki taraf se jawab milta hai tu thande kaleje chala ja, us ke liye jo kuch main ne tayyar kiya hai agar tu use dekh leta toh tu bahut hansta aur bilkul azurda na hota. Phir jab dusra dost marta hai aur un ki ruhein milti hain toh kaha jata hai ke tum aapas mein ek dusre ka ta'alluq bayan karo, pas har ek dusre se kehta hai ke yeh mera bada achha bhai tha aur nihayat nek sathi tha aur bahut behtar dost tha. Do kafir jo aapas mein ek dusre ke dost the jab un mein se ek marta hai aur jahannam ki khabar diya jata hai toh use bhi apna dost yaad aata hai aur kehta hai Bari Ta'ala! Fulan shakhs mera dost tha, teri aur tere Nabi ki nafarmani ki mujhe ta'leem deta tha, buraiyon ki raghbat dilata tha, bhalaiyon se rokta tha aur teri mulaqat na hone ka mujhe yaqeen dilata tha, pas tu use mere baad hidayat na kar ta-ke woh bhi wahi dekhe jo main ne dekha aur us par tu isi tarah naraz ho jis tarah mujh par ghazab-nak hua. Phir jab dusra dost marta hai aur un ki ruhein jama ki jati hain toh kaha jata hai ke tum dono ek dusre ke ausaf bayan karo toh har ek kehta hai tu bada bura bhai tha aur badtareen dost tha. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas aur Hazrat Mujahid aur Hazrat Qatada farmate hain har dosti qayamat ke din dushmani se badal jayegi magar parhezgaron ki dosti.

Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai ke jin do shakhson ne Allah ke liye aapas mein dostana kar rakha hai khwah ek mashriq mein ho aur dusra maghrib mein lekin Qayamat ke din Allah unhein jama kar ke farmayega ke yeh jise tu meri wajah se chahta tha. Phir farmaya ke in muttaqiyon se roz-e-Qayamat mein kaha jayega ke tum khauf-o-haras se door ho. Har tarah aman-o-chain se raho saho yeh hai tumhare iman-o-Islam ka badla. Ya'ni batin mein yaqeen-o-etiqad-e-kamil. Aur zahir mein shariat par amal. Hazrat Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Qayamat ke din jab ke log apni apni qabron se khade kiye jayenge. To sab ke sab ghabrahat aur be-chaini mein honge us waqt ek munadi nida karega ke ae mere bando! Aaj ke din na tum par khauf hai na gham to tamam ke tamam ise aam samajh kar khush ho jayenge wahin munadi kahega woh log jo dil se iman laye the aur jism se nek kaam kiye the us waqt siwaye sache pakke musalmanon ke baqi sab mayoos ho jayenge phir un se kaha jayega ke tum ne'mat-o-sa'adat ke sath Jannat mein dakhil ho jao. Surah Rum mein is ki tafsir guzar chuki hai. Charon taraf se un ke samne tarah tarah ke mulazziz muragghan khush-zaiqa marghoob khanon ki tashtariyan, rakabiyan aur piyaliyan pesh hongi aur chhalkte hue jaam hathon mein liye ghilman idhar udhar gardish kar rahe honge. Subh-o-sham sattar sattar hazar rakabiyan piyale alag alag waza ke khane se pur us ke samne rakhe jayenge jin mein se har ek us ki khwahish ke mutabiq hoga. Aur awwal se akhir tak us ki ishtaha barabar aur yaksan rahegi. Agar woh roo-e-zameen walon ki dawat kar de to sab ko kifayat ho jaye aur kuch na ghate (Abdur Razzaq). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se adna martabe ke Jannati ke bala khane ki saat manzilein hongi yeh chhati manzil mein hoga aur us ke upar saatwin hogi us ke tees khadim honge jo subh-o-sham teen sau sone ke bartanon mein us ke ta'am-o-sharab pesh karenge har ek mein alag alag qisam ka ajeeb-o-ghareeb aur nihayat lazeez khana hoga awwal se akhir tak use khane ki ishtaha waisi hi rahegi. Isi tarah teen sau sone ke piyalon aur katoron aur glasson mein use peene ki cheezein di jayengi.

Phir farmaya ke in muttaqiyon se roz-e-Qayamat mein kaha jayega ke tum khauf-o-haras se door ho. Har tarah aman-o-chain se raho saho yeh hai tumhare iman-o-Islam ka badla. Ya'ni batin mein yaqeen-o-etiqad-e-kamil. Aur zahir mein shariat par amal. Hazrat Mu'tamir bin Sulaiman apne walid se riwayat karte hain ke Qayamat ke din jab ke log apni apni qabron se khade kiye jayenge. To sab ke sab ghabrahat aur be-chaini mein honge us waqt ek munadi nida karega ke ae mere bando! Aaj ke din na tum par khauf hai na gham to tamam ke tamam ise aam samajh kar khush ho jayenge wahin munadi kahega woh log jo dil se iman laye the aur jism se nek kaam kiye the us waqt siwaye sache pakke musalmanon ke baqi sab mayoos ho jayenge phir un se kaha jayega ke tum ne'mat-o-sa'adat ke sath Jannat mein dakhil ho jao. Surah Rum mein is ki tafsir guzar chuki hai. Charon taraf se un ke samne tarah tarah ke mulazziz muragghan khush-zaiqa marghoob khanon ki tashtariyan, rakabiyan aur piyaliyan pesh hongi aur chhalkte hue jaam hathon mein liye ghilman idhar udhar gardish kar rahe honge. Ayat (Tushtahi-ul-Anfus) aur (Tashtahi-ul-Anfus) dono qiratein hain. Yunhi unhein mazedar khushbu wale achi rangat wale man-mane khane peene milenge. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se neeche darje ka Jannati jo sab se akhir mein Jannat mein jayega us ki nigah sau saal ke raste tak jati hogi lekin barabar wahan tak use apne hi dere aur mahal sone ke zumurrad ke nazar aayenge jo tamam ke tamam qisam qisam aur rang barang ke saaz-o-saman se pur honge. Subh-o-sham sattar sattar hazar rakabiyan piyale alag alag waza ke khane se pur us ke samne rakhe jayenge jin mein se har ek us ki khwahish ke mutabiq hoga. Aur awwal se akhir tak us ki ishtaha barabar aur yaksan rahegi. Agar woh roo-e-zameen walon ki dawat kar de to sab ko kifayat ho jaye aur kuch na ghate (Abdur Razzaq). Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jannat ka zikr karte hue farmaya ke Jannati ek luqma uthayega aur us ke dil mein khayal aayega ke falan qisam ka khana hota to acha hota chunancha woh niwala us ke munh mein woh cheez ban jayega jis ki us ne khwahish ki thi phir aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se adna martabe ke Jannati ke bala khane ki saat manzilein hongi yeh chhati manzil mein hoga aur us ke upar saatwin hogi us ke tees khadim honge jo subh-o-sham teen sau sone ke bartanon mein us ke ta'am-o-sharab pesh karenge har ek mein alag alag qisam ka ajeeb-o-ghareeb aur nihayat lazeez khana hoga awwal se akhir tak use khane ki ishtaha waisi hi rahegi. Isi tarah teen sau sone ke piyalon aur katoron aur glasson mein use peene ki cheezein di jayengi.

Woh bhi ek se ek sawa hogi, yeh kahe ga ke ae Allah agar tu mujhe ijazat de toh main tamam jannatiyon ki dawat karoon. Sab bhi agar mere yahan kha jayen toh bhi mere khane mein kami nahin aa sakti aur us ki behtar biwiyan hoor-e-ain mein se hongi. Aur duniya ki biwiyan alag hongi. In mein se ek ek meel meel bhar ki jagah mein baithe gi, phir sath hi un se kaha jaye ga ke yeh ne'matein bhi hamesha rehne wali hain aur tum bhi yahan hamesha rahoge. Na maut aaye, na ghata aaye, na jagah badle, na takleef pohanche. Phir un par apna fazl-o-ehsan bataya jata hai ke tumhare a'maal ka badla main ne apni wasee rahmat se tumhein yeh diya hai. Kyunke koi shakhs baghair rahmat-e-Allah ke sirf apne a'maal ki bina par jannat mein nahin ja sakta. Albata jannat ke darjon mein tafawut jo hoga woh nek a'maal ke tafawut ki wajah se hoga. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain jahannami apni jannat ki jagah jahannam mein dekhenge aur hasrat-o-afsos se kahenge agar Allah Ta'ala mujhe bhi hidayat karta toh main bhi muttaqiyon mein ho jata. Aur har ek jannati bhi apni jahannam ki jagah jannat mein se dekhe ga aur Allah ka shukr karte hue kahe ga ke hum khud apne taur par rah-e-rast ke hasil karne par qadir na thay, agar Allah Ta'ala khud hamari rehnumai na karta. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain har har shakhs ki ek jagah jannat mein hai aur ek jagah jahannam mein. Pas kafir momin ki jahannam ki jagah ka waris hoga aur momin kafir ki jannat ki jagah ka waris hoga. Yehi farman-e-bari hai, is jannat ke waris tum ba-sabab apne a'maal ke banaye gaye ho. Khane peene ke zikr ke baad ab mewon aur tarkariyon ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh bhi ba-kasrat marghoob-e-tab'a unhein milengi. Jis qisam ki yeh chahein aur un ki khwahish ho. Gharz bharpoor ne'maton ke sath Rabb ke razamandi ke ghar mein hamesha rahenge, Allah hamein bhi naseeb farmaye. Ameen.

Jannat mein jannat ke haqdar Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke dekho toh yeh mushrik qayamat ka intezar kar rahe hain jo mehez besood hai is liye ke is ke aane ka kisi ko sahi waqt toh maloom nahin woh achanak yunhi bekhabari ki halat mein aajayegi us waqt go nadim hon lekin is se kya fayda? Yeh ise namumkin samjhe hue hain lekin woh na sirf mumkin balkay yaqeenan aane hi wali hai aur us waqt ka ya us ke baad ka koi amal kisi ko kuch nafa na de ga. Us din toh jin ki dostiyan ghair-Allah ke liye thin woh sab adawat se badal jayengi yahan jo dosti Allah ke waste thi woh baqi aur da'im rahegi. Jaise Khalil-ur-Rahman A.S ne apni qoum se farmaya tha ke tum ne buton se jo dostiyan kar rakhi hain yeh sirf duniya ke rehne tak hi hain qayamat ke din toh ek dusre ka na sirf inkar karenge balkay ek dusre par la'nat bhi bhejenge aur tumhara thikana jahannam hoga aur koi na hoga jo tumhari imdad par aaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein marvi hai ke Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ali Karam Allah Wajhahu farmate hain do imandar jo aapas mein dost hote hain jab un mein se ek ka inteqal hojata hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se use jannat ki khushkhabri milti hai toh woh apne dost ko yaad karta hai aur kehta hai ae Allah! Fulan shakhs mera dili dost tha jo mujhe tere aur tere Rasool ki ita'at ka hukum deta tha, bhalai ki hidayat karta tha, burai se rokta tha aur mujhe yaqeen dilaya karta tha ke ek roz Allah se milna hai, pas ae Bari Ta'ala! Tu use rah-e-haq par sabit qadam rakh yahan tak ke use bhi tu woh dikhaye jo tu ne mujhe dikhaya hai aur us se bhi isi tarah razi hojaye jis tarah mujh se razi hua hai. Allah ki taraf se jawab milta hai tu thande kaleje chala ja, us ke liye jo kuch main ne tayyar kiya hai agar tu use dekh leta toh tu bahut hansta aur bilkul azurda na hota. Fulan shakhs mera dost tha, teri aur tere Nabi ki nafarmani ki mujhe ta'leem deta tha, buraiyon ki raghbat dilata tha, bhalaiyon se rokta tha aur teri mulaqat na hone ka mujhe yaqeen dilata tha, pas tu use mere baad hidayat na kar ta-ke woh bhi wahi dekhe jo main ne dekha aur us par tu isi tarah naraz ho jis tarah mujh par ghazab-nak hua. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain har har shakhs ki ek jagah jannat mein hai aur ek jagah jahannam mein. Pas kafir momin ki jahannam ki jagah ka waris hoga aur momin kafir ki jannat ki jagah ka waris hoga. Yehi farman-e-bari hai, is jannat ke waris tum ba-sabab apne a'maal ke banaye gaye ho. Khane peene ke zikr ke baad ab mewon aur tarkariyon ka bayan ho raha hai ke yeh bhi ba-kasrat marghoob-e-tab'a unhein milengi. Jis qisam ki yeh chahein aur un ki khwahish ho. Gharz bharpoor ne'maton ke sath Rabb ke razamandi ke ghar mein hamesha rahenge, Allah hamein bhi naseeb farmaye. Ameen.

Dozakh aur dozakhiyon ki dargat: Upar chunke nek logon ka haal bayan hua tha is liye yahan badbakhton ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke yeh gunahgar jahannam ke azabon mein hamesha rahenge, ek sa'at bhi unhein in azabon mein takhfeef na hogi aur is mein woh na-umeed mahz ho kar pade rahenge, har bhalai se woh mayus ho jayenge. Hum zulm karne wale nahin balkeh unhon ne khud apni bad-a'maliyon ki wajah se apni jaan par aap hi zulm kiya. Hum ne Rasool bheje, kitabein nazil farmayin, hujjat qaim kar di lekin yeh apni sarkashi se, isyan se, tughyan se baaz na aaye, is par yeh badla paya. Is mein Allah ka koi zulm nahin aur na Allah apne bandon par zulm karta hai. Yeh jahannami Malik ko yani darogha-e-jahannam ko pukarenge. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh maut ki aarzu karenge taake azab se chhoot jayen lekin Allah ka yeh faisla ho chuka hai ke (وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ 36؀ۚ) (35. Fatir: 36) yani na toh unhein maut aayegi aur na azab ki takhfeef hogi. Aur farman-e-Bari hai aayat (وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْاَشْقَى 11 ۙ) (87. Al-A'la: 11) yani woh badbakht is nasihat se alaihida ho jayega jo badi sakht aag mein pade ga, phir wahan na marega aur na jiye ga. Pas jab yeh darogha-e-jahannam se nihayat lajajat se kahenge ke aap hamari maut ki dua Allah se kijiye toh woh jawab dega ke tum isi mein pade rehne wale ho, maroge nahin. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain makth ek hazar saal hai. Yani na maroge, na chhutkara paoge, na bhaag sakoge. Phir un ki siyah-kari ka bayan ho raha hai ke jab hum ne un ke samne haq ko pesh kar diya, wazeh kar diya toh unhon ne use manna toh ek taraf, us se nafrat ki. Un ki tabiyat hi is taraf mail na hui, haq aur haq walon se nafrat karte rahe, us se rukte rahe, haan na-haq ki taraf mail rahe, na-haq walon se un ki khoob banti rahi. Pas tum apne nafs ko yahi malamat karo aur apne hi upar afsos karo lekin aaj ka afsos bhi be-faida hai. Phir farmata hai ke unhon ne badtareen makr aur zabardast daao khelna chaha toh hum ne bhi un ke sath yahi kiya. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ki yahi tafsir hai aur is ki shahadat is aayat mein hai (وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا وَّمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ 50؀) (27. An-Naml: 50) yani unhon ne makr kiya aur hum ne bhi is tarah makr kiya ke unhein pata bhi na chala. Mushrikeen haq ko taalne ke liye tarah tarah ki heela-sazi karte rehte the. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi unhein dhoke mein hi rakha aur un ka wabaal jab tak un ke saron par na aa gaya aur un ki aankhein na khulin. Isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke kya un ka guman hai ke hum un ki posheeda baatein aur khufiya sargoshiyan sun nahin rahe? Un ka guman bilkul ghalat hai, hum toh un ki sarisht tak se waqif hain balkeh hamare muqarrar karda farishte bhi un ke paas balkeh un ke sath hain jo na sirf dekh hi rahe hain balkeh likh bhi rahe hain.

Un ka guman bilkul ghalat hai, hum toh un ki sarisht tak se waqif hain balkeh hamare muqarrar karda farishte bhi un ke paas balkeh un ke sath hain jo na sirf dekh hi rahe hain balkeh likh bhi rahe hain.

Dozakh aur dozakhiyon ki dargat: Upar chunke nek logon ka haal bayan hua tha is liye yahan badbakhton ka haal bayan ho raha hai ke yeh gunahgar jahannam ke azabon mein hamesha rahenge, ek sa'at bhi unhein in azabon mein takhfeef na hogi aur is mein woh na-umeed mahz ho kar pade rahenge, har bhalai se woh mayus ho jayenge. Hum zulm karne wale nahin balkeh unhon ne khud apni bad-a'maliyon ki wajah se apni jaan par aap hi zulm kiya. Hum ne Rasool bheje, kitabein nazil farmayin, hujjat qaim kar di lekin yeh apni sarkashi se, isyan se, tughyan se baaz na aaye, is par yeh badla paya. Is mein Allah ka koi zulm nahin aur na Allah apne bandon par zulm karta hai. Yeh jahannami Malik ko yani darogha-e-jahannam ko pukarenge. Sahih Bukhari mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mimbar par is aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya yeh maut ki aarzu karenge taake azab se chhoot jayen lekin Allah ka yeh faisla ho chuka hai ke (وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ 36؀ۚ) (35. Fatir: 36) yani na toh unhein maut aayegi aur na azab ki takhfeef hogi. Aur farman-e-Bari hai aayat (وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْاَشْقَى 11 ۙ) (87. Al-A'la: 11) yani woh badbakht is nasihat se alaihida ho jayega jo badi sakht aag mein pade ga, phir wahan na marega aur na jiye ga. Pas jab yeh darogha-e-jahannam se nihayat lajajat se kahenge ke aap hamari maut ki dua Allah se kijiye toh woh jawab dega ke tum isi mein pade rehne wale ho, maroge nahin. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain makth ek hazar saal hai. Yani na maroge, na chhutkara paoge, na bhaag sakoge. Phir un ki siyah-kari ka bayan ho raha hai ke jab hum ne un ke samne haq ko pesh kar diya, wazeh kar diya toh unhon ne use manna toh ek taraf, us se nafrat ki. Un ki tabiyat hi is taraf mail na hui, haq aur haq walon se nafrat karte rahe, us se rukte rahe, haan na-haq ki taraf mail rahe, na-haq walon se un ki khoob banti rahi. Pas tum apne nafs ko yahi malamat karo aur apne hi upar afsos karo lekin aaj ka afsos bhi be-faida hai. Phir farmata hai ke unhon ne badtareen makr aur zabardast daao khelna chaha toh hum ne bhi un ke sath yahi kiya. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ki yahi tafsir hai aur is ki shahadat is aayat mein hai (وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا وَّمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ 50؀) (27. An-Naml: 50) yani unhon ne makr kiya aur hum ne bhi is tarah makr kiya ke unhein pata bhi na chala. Mushrikeen haq ko taalne ke liye tarah tarah ki heela-sazi karte rehte the. Allah Ta'ala ne bhi unhein dhoke mein hi rakha aur un ka wabaal jab tak un ke saron par na aa gaya aur un ki aankhein na khulin. Isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke kya un ka guman hai ke hum un ki posheeda baatein aur khufiya sargoshiyan sun nahin rahe? Un ka guman bilkul ghalat hai, hum toh un ki sarisht tak se waqif hain balkeh hamare muqarrar karda farishte bhi un ke paas balkeh un ke sath hain jo na sirf dekh hi rahe hain balkeh likh bhi rahe hain.

Jahalat-o-khabasat ki inteha Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk hai. Aye Nabi (ﷺ)! Aap elaan kar dijiye ke agar bilfarz Allah Ta'ala ki aulad ho to mujhe sar jhukane mein kya ta'ammul hai? Na main uske farman se sartabi karoon na uske hukum ko taloon. Agar aisa hota to sab se pehle main use manta aur uska iqrar karta, lekin Allah ki zaat aisi nahin jiska koi hamsar aur jiska koi kufw ho. Yaad rahe ke bator-e-shart ke jo kalam warid kiya jaye uska waqoo zaroori nahin balkay imkan bhi zaroori nahin. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai: Ayat (Lau aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu huwallahul wahidul qahhar) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4), yani agar Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla-o-Ala aulad ki khwahish karta to apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta chun leta, lekin woh is se pak hai. Uski shan-e-wahdaniyat iske khilaf hai, uska tanha ghalba aur qahariyat iske sarih munafi hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne (Aabideen) ke ma'ani inkari ke bhi kiye hain, jaise Sufyan Thauri (R.H). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke (Aabideen) se murad yahan (Awwalul Jahideen) hai, yani pehla inkar karne wala aur yeh (Abada-Ya'budu) ke baab se hai aur jo ibadat ke ma'ani mein hota hai, woh (Abada-Ya'budu) se hota hai. Isi ki shahadat mein yeh waqia bhi hai ke ek aurat ke nikah ke chhe mah baad bacha hua, Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use rajam karne ka hukum diya lekin Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne iski mukhalifat ki aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein hai: Ayat (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15), yani hamal ki aur doodh ki chhutai ki muddat dhai saal ki hai. Aur jagah Allah Azza-o-Jal ne farmaya: Ayat (Wa fisaluhu fi 'amain), do saal ke andar andar doodh chhudane ki muddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) unka inkar na kar sake aur foran aadmi bheja ke is aurat ko wapas karo. Yahan bhi lafz (Abada) hai, yani inkar na kar sake. Ibn-e-Wahb (R.H) kehte hain (Abada) ke ma'ani na manna, inkar karna hai. Shair ke sher mein bhi (Abada) inkar ke aur na manne ke ma'ani mein hai. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, is liye ke shart ke jawab mein yeh kuch theek tor par lagta nahin. Ise manne ke baad matlab yeh hoga ke agar Rahman ki aulad hai to main pehla munkir hoon aur is mein kalam ki khoobsurti qaim nahin rehti. Haan sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke (In) shart ke liye nahin hai balkay nafi ke liye hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool bhi hai. To ab mazmoon-e-kalam yeh hoga ke chunke Rahman ki aulad nahin, pas main uska pehla gawah hoon. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain yeh kalam Arab ke muhawaray ke mutabiq hai, yani na Rahman ki aulad, na main uska qail-o-aabid. Abu Sakhr (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke main to pehle hi uska aabid hoon ke uski aulad hai hi nahin aur main uski tauheed ko manne mein bhi aagay aagay hoon. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain main uska pehla ibadat guzar hoon aur muwahhid hoon aur tumhari takzeeb karne wala hoon.

Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain main pehla inkari hoon yeh dono lughat mein (Aabid) aur (Abd) aur awwal hi zyada qareeb hai is wajah se ke yeh shart-o-jaza hai lekin yeh mumtani aur muhaal mehaz namumkin. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain agar is ki aulad hoti toh main ise pehle maan leta ke is ki aulad hai lekin woh is se paak hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur jo log (An) ko nafiya batlate hain un ke qaul ki tardeed karte hain. Isi liye Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur tamam cheezon ka haal is se paak bahut door aur bilkul munazzah hai ke is ki aulad ho. Woh Fard, Ahad, Samad hai, is ki nazeer, kufw, aulad koi nahin. Irshad hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe apni jahalat mein ghote khate chhodo aur duniya ke khel tamashon mein mashghool rehne do, isi ghaflat mein in par Qayamat toot padegi. Us waqt apna anjam maloom kar lenge. Phir Zaat-e-Haq ki buzurgi aur azmat aur jalal ka mazeed bayan hota hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooqat is ki aabid hai, is ke samne past aur aajiz hai. Woh Khabeer-o-Aleem hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke zameen-o-aasman mein Allah wahi hai, har posheeda aur zahir ko aur tumhare har har amal ko janta hai. Woh sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik, sab ko basane aur banane wala, sab par hukumat aur saltanat rakhne wala, badi barkaton wala hai. Woh tamam aibon se, kul nuqsanat se paak hai, woh sab ka malik hai, bulandiyon aur azmaton wala hai, koi nahin jo is ka hukum taal sake, koi nahin jo is ki marzi badal sake, har ek par qabiz wahi hai, har ek kaam is ki qudrat ke tahat hai. Qayamat aane ke waqt ko wahi janta hai, is ke siwa kisi ko is ke aane ke theek waqt ka ilm nahin. Sari makhlooq isi ki taraf lautayi jayegi, woh har ek ko apne apne aamal ka badla dega. Phir irshad hota hai ke in kafiron ke maboodan-e-batil jinhein yeh apna sifarshi khayal kiye baithe hain, un mein se koi bhi sifarish ke liye aage badh nahin sakta, kisi ki shafa'at inhe kaam na aayegi. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, yani lekin jo shakhs haq ka iqrari aur shahid ho aur woh khud bhi baseerat-o-basarat par yani ilm-o-ma'rifat wala ho, use Allah ke hukum se nek logon ki shafa'at kaar-aamad hogi. In se agar tu pooche ke in ka Khaliq kaun hai? Toh yeh iqrar karenge ke Allah hi hai. Afsos ke Khaliq isi ek ko maan kar phir ibadat dusron ki bhi karte hain jo mehaz majboor aur bilkul be-qudrat hain aur kabhi apni aql ko kaam mein nahin late ke jab paida isi ek ne kiya toh hum dusre ki ibadat kyun karein? Jahalat-o-khabasat, kund zehni aur be-waqoofi itni badh gayi hai ke aisi seedhi si baat marte dam tak samajh na aayi. Balkeh samjhane se bhi na samjha, isi liye ta'ajjub se irshad hua ke itna maante hue phir kyun andhe ho jate ho? Phir irshad hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna yeh kehna kaha yani apne Rab ki taraf shikayat ki aur apni qaum ki takzeeb ka bayan kiya ke yeh iman qabool nahin karte, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَقَال الرَّسُوْلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوْا ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا 30؀) 25.

Is ki ek taujih toh yeh ho sakti hai ke aayat (Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum, bala wa rusuluna ladaihim yaktubun) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 80) par ma'toof hai, dusre yeh ke yahan fe'l muqaddar mana jaye ya'ni (Qala) ko muqaddar mana jaye. Agar aisa hota to sab se pehle main use manta aur uska iqrar karta, lekin Allah ki zaat aisi nahin jiska koi hamsar aur jiska koi kufw ho. Yaad rahe ke bator-e-shart ke jo kalam warid kiya jaye uska waqoo zaroori nahin balkay imkan bhi zaroori nahin. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai: Ayat (Lau aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu huwallahul wahidul qahhar) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4), yani agar Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla-o-Ala aulad ki khwahish karta to apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta chun leta, lekin woh is se pak hai. Uski shan-e-wahdaniyat iske khilaf hai, uska tanha ghalba aur qahariyat iske sarih munafi hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne (Aabideen) ke ma'ani inkari ke bhi kiye hain, jaise Sufyan Thauri (R.H). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke (Aabideen) se murad yahan (Awwalul Jahideen) hai, yani pehla inkar karne wala aur yeh (Abada-Ya'budu) ke baab se hai aur jo ibadat ke ma'ani mein hota hai, woh (Abada-Ya'budu) se hota hai. Isi ki shahadat mein yeh waqia bhi hai ke ek aurat ke nikah ke chhe mah baad bacha hua, Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use rajam karne ka hukum diya lekin Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne iski mukhalifat ki aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein hai: Ayat (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15), yani hamal ki aur doodh ki chhutai ki muddat dhai saal ki hai. Aur jagah Allah Azza-o-Jal ne farmaya: Ayat (Wa fisaluhu fi 'amain), do saal ke andar andar doodh chhudane ki muddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) unka inkar na kar sake aur foran aadmi bheja ke is aurat ko wapas karo. Yahan bhi lafz (Abada) hai, yani inkar na kar sake. Ibn-e-Wahb (R.H) kehte hain (Abada) ke ma'ani na manna, inkar karna hai. Shair ke sher mein bhi (Abada) inkar ke aur na manne ke ma'ani mein hai. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, is liye ke shart ke jawab mein yeh kuch theek tor par lagta nahin. Ise manne ke baad matlab yeh hoga ke agar Rahman ki aulad hai to main pehla munkir hoon aur is mein kalam ki khoobsurti qaim nahin rehti. Haan sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke (In) shart ke liye nahin hai balkay nafi ke liye hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool bhi hai. To ab mazmoon-e-kalam yeh hoga ke chunke Rahman ki aulad nahin, pas main uska pehla gawah hoon. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain yeh kalam Arab ke muhawaray ke mutabiq hai, yani na Rahman ki aulad, na main uska qail-o-aabid. Abu Sakhr (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke main to pehle hi uska aabid hoon ke uski aulad hai hi nahin aur main uski tauheed ko manne mein bhi aagay aagay hoon. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain main uska pehla ibadat guzar hoon aur muwahhid hoon aur tumhari takzeeb karne wala hoon.

Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain main pehla inkari hoon yeh dono lughat mein (Aabid) aur (Abd) aur awwal hi zyada qareeb hai is wajah se ke yeh shart-o-jaza hai lekin yeh mumtani aur muhaal mehaz namumkin. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain agar is ki aulad hoti toh main ise pehle maan leta ke is ki aulad hai lekin woh is se paak hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur jo log (An) ko nafiya batlate hain un ke qaul ki tardeed karte hain. Isi liye Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur tamam cheezon ka haal is se paak bahut door aur bilkul munazzah hai ke is ki aulad ho. Woh Fard, Ahad, Samad hai, is ki nazeer, kufw, aulad koi nahin. Irshad hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe apni jahalat mein ghote khate chhodo aur duniya ke khel tamashon mein mashghool rehne do, isi ghaflat mein in par Qayamat toot padegi. Us waqt apna anjam maloom kar lenge. Phir Zaat-e-Haq ki buzurgi aur azmat aur jalal ka mazeed bayan hota hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooqat is ki aabid hai, is ke samne past aur aajiz hai. Woh Khabeer-o-Aleem hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke zameen-o-aasman mein Allah wahi hai, har posheeda aur zahir ko aur tumhare har har amal ko janta hai. Woh sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik, sab ko basane aur banane wala, sab par hukumat aur saltanat rakhne wala, badi barkaton wala hai. Woh tamam aibon se, kul nuqsanat se paak hai, woh sab ka malik hai, bulandiyon aur azmaton wala hai, koi nahin jo is ka hukum taal sake, koi nahin jo is ki marzi badal sake, har ek par qabiz wahi hai, har ek kaam is ki qudrat ke tahat hai. Qayamat aane ke waqt ko wahi janta hai, is ke siwa kisi ko is ke aane ke theek waqt ka ilm nahin. Sari makhlooq isi ki taraf lautayi jayegi, woh har ek ko apne apne aamal ka badla dega. Phir irshad hota hai ke in kafiron ke maboodan-e-batil jinhein yeh apna sifarshi khayal kiye baithe hain, un mein se koi bhi sifarish ke liye aage badh nahin sakta, kisi ki shafa'at inhe kaam na aayegi. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, yani lekin jo shakhs haq ka iqrari aur shahid ho aur woh khud bhi baseerat-o-basarat par yani ilm-o-ma'rifat wala ho, use Allah ke hukum se nek logon ki shafa'at kaar-aamad hogi. In se agar tu pooche ke in ka Khaliq kaun hai? Toh yeh iqrar karenge ke Allah hi hai. Afsos ke Khaliq isi ek ko maan kar phir ibadat dusron ki bhi karte hain jo mehaz majboor aur bilkul be-qudrat hain aur kabhi apni aql ko kaam mein nahin late ke jab paida isi ek ne kiya toh hum dusre ki ibadat kyun karein? Jahalat-o-khabasat, kund zehni aur be-waqoofi itni badh gayi hai ke aisi seedhi si baat marte dam tak samajh na aayi. Balkeh samjhane se bhi na samjha, isi liye ta'ajjub se irshad hua ke itna maante hue phir kyun andhe ho jate ho? Phir irshad hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna yeh kehna kaha yani apne Rab ki taraf shikayat ki aur apni qaum ki takzeeb ka bayan kiya ke yeh iman qabool nahin karte, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَقَال الرَّسُوْلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوْا ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا 30؀) 25.

Is ki ek taujih toh yeh ho sakti hai ke aayat (Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum, bala wa rusuluna ladaihim yaktubun) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 80) par ma'toof hai, dusre yeh ke yahan fe'l muqaddar mana jaye ya'ni (Qala) ko muqaddar mana jaye. Dusri qirat ya'ni 'laam' ke zer ke sath jab ho toh yeh ataf hoga aayat (Wa indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa ilaihi turja'un) (43. Woh sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik, sab ko basane aur banane wala, sab par hukumat aur saltanat rakhne wala, badi barkaton wala hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke in kafiron ke maboodan-e-batil jinhein yeh apna sifarshi khayal kiye baithe hain, un mein se koi bhi sifarish ke liye aage badh nahin sakta, kisi ki shafa'at inhe kaam na aayegi. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, yani lekin jo shakhs haq ka iqrari aur shahid ho aur woh khud bhi baseerat-o-basarat par yani ilm-o-ma'rifat wala ho, use Allah ke hukum se nek logon ki shafa'at kaar-aamad hogi. Jahalat-o-khabasat, kund zehni aur be-waqoofi itni badh gayi hai ke aisi seedhi si baat marte dam tak samajh na aayi.
