Phir irshad hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apna yeh kehna kaha yani apne Rab ki taraf shikayat ki aur apni qaum ki takzeeb ka bayan kiya ke yeh iman qabool nahin karte, jaise aur aayat mein hai (وَقَال الرَّسُوْلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوْا ھٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا 30؀) 25.

(Al-Furqan: 30) Ya'ni Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh shikayat Allah ke samne hogi ke meri ummat ne is Quran ko chhor rakha tha. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi yahi tafsir bayan karte hain. Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki qirat 'laam' ke zer ke sath bhi naqal ki hai. Is ki ek taujih toh yeh ho sakti hai ke aayat (Am yahsabuna anna la nasma'u sirrahum wa najwahum, bala wa rusuluna ladaihim yaktubun) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 80) par ma'toof hai, dusre yeh ke yahan fe'l muqaddar mana jaye ya'ni (Qala) ko muqaddar mana jaye. Dusri qirat ya'ni 'laam' ke zer ke sath jab ho toh yeh ataf hoga aayat (Wa indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa ilaihi turja'un) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 85) par, toh taqdeer yun hogi ke Qayamat ka ilm aur is qaul ka ilm Us ke paas hai. Khatm-e-Surah par irshad hota hai ke mushrikeen se munh mor le aur un ki bad-zabani ka bad-kalami se jawab na do, balkeh un ke dil par chhane ki khatir qaul mein aur fe'l mein dono mein narmi barto, keh do ke salam hai. Unhein abhi haqiqat-e-haal maloom ho jayegi. Is mein Rabb-e-Quddus ki taraf se mushrikeen ko bari dhamki hai aur yahi ho kar bhi raha, ke un par woh azab aaya jo un se tal na saka. Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla Wa 'Ala ne apne deen ko buland-o-bala kiya, apne kalma ko charon taraf phaila diya, apne muwahhid, momin aur muslim bandon ko qawi kar diya aur phir unhein jihad ke aur jala-watan karne ke ahkaam de kar is tarah duniya mein ghalib kar diya. Allah ke deen mein beshumar aadmi dakhil huye aur mashriq-o-maghrib mein Islam phail gaya. Falhamdulillah. Wallahu A'lam.

Jahalat-o-khabasat ki inteha Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk hai. Aye Nabi (ﷺ)! Aap elaan kar dijiye ke agar bilfarz Allah Ta'ala ki aulad ho to mujhe sar jhukane mein kya ta'ammul hai? Na main uske farman se sartabi karoon na uske hukum ko taloon. Agar aisa hota to sab se pehle main use manta aur uska iqrar karta, lekin Allah ki zaat aisi nahin jiska koi hamsar aur jiska koi kufw ho. Yaad rahe ke bator-e-shart ke jo kalam warid kiya jaye uska waqoo zaroori nahin balkay imkan bhi zaroori nahin. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai: Ayat (Lau aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu huwallahul wahidul qahhar) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4), yani agar Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla-o-Ala aulad ki khwahish karta to apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta chun leta, lekin woh is se pak hai. Uski shan-e-wahdaniyat iske khilaf hai, uska tanha ghalba aur qahariyat iske sarih munafi hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne (Aabideen) ke ma'ani inkari ke bhi kiye hain, jaise Sufyan Thauri (R.H). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke (Aabideen) se murad yahan (Awwalul Jahideen) hai, yani pehla inkar karne wala aur yeh (Abada-Ya'budu) ke baab se hai aur jo ibadat ke ma'ani mein hota hai, woh (Abada-Ya'budu) se hota hai. Isi ki shahadat mein yeh waqia bhi hai ke ek aurat ke nikah ke chhe mah baad bacha hua, Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use rajam karne ka hukum diya lekin Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne iski mukhalifat ki aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein hai: Ayat (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15), yani hamal ki aur doodh ki chhutai ki muddat dhai saal ki hai. Aur jagah Allah Azza-o-Jal ne farmaya: Ayat (Wa fisaluhu fi 'amain), do saal ke andar andar doodh chhudane ki muddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) unka inkar na kar sake aur foran aadmi bheja ke is aurat ko wapas karo. Yahan bhi lafz (Abada) hai, yani inkar na kar sake. Ibn-e-Wahb (R.H) kehte hain (Abada) ke ma'ani na manna, inkar karna hai. Shair ke sher mein bhi (Abada) inkar ke aur na manne ke ma'ani mein hai. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, is liye ke shart ke jawab mein yeh kuch theek tor par lagta nahin. Ise manne ke baad matlab yeh hoga ke agar Rahman ki aulad hai to main pehla munkir hoon aur is mein kalam ki khoobsurti qaim nahin rehti. Haan sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke (In) shart ke liye nahin hai balkay nafi ke liye hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool bhi hai. To ab mazmoon-e-kalam yeh hoga ke chunke Rahman ki aulad nahin, pas main uska pehla gawah hoon. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain yeh kalam Arab ke muhawaray ke mutabiq hai, yani na Rahman ki aulad, na main uska qail-o-aabid. Jahalat-o-khabasat ki inteha Allah Ta'ala ke sath shirk hai. Aye Nabi (ﷺ)! Aap elaan kar dijiye ke agar bilfarz Allah Ta'ala ki aulad ho to mujhe sar jhukane mein kya ta'ammul hai? Na main uske farman se sartabi karoon na uske hukum ko taloon. Agar aisa hota to sab se pehle main use manta aur uska iqrar karta, lekin Allah ki zaat aisi nahin jiska koi hamsar aur jiska koi kufw ho. Yaad rahe ke bator-e-shart ke jo kalam warid kiya jaye uska waqoo zaroori nahin balkay imkan bhi zaroori nahin. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai: Ayat (Lau aradallahu an yattakhiza waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu huwallahul wahidul qahhar) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4), yani agar Hazrat-e-Haq Jalla-o-Ala aulad ki khwahish karta to apni makhlooq mein se jise chahta chun leta, lekin woh is se pak hai. Uski shan-e-wahdaniyat iske khilaf hai, uska tanha ghalba aur qahariyat iske sarih munafi hai. Ba'az mufassireen ne (Aabideen) ke ma'ani inkari ke bhi kiye hain, jaise Sufyan Thauri (R.H). Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke (Aabideen) se murad yahan (Awwalul Jahideen) hai, yani pehla inkar karne wala aur yeh (Abada-Ya'budu) ke baab se hai aur jo ibadat ke ma'ani mein hota hai, woh (Abada-Ya'budu) se hota hai. Isi ki shahadat mein yeh waqia bhi hai ke ek aurat ke nikah ke chhe mah baad bacha hua, Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne use rajam karne ka hukum diya lekin Hazrat Ali (R.A) ne iski mukhalifat ki aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ki kitab mein hai: Ayat (Wa hamluhu wa fisaluhu thalathuna shahra) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 15), yani hamal ki aur doodh ki chhutai ki muddat dhai saal ki hai. Aur jagah Allah Azza-o-Jal ne farmaya: Ayat (Wa fisaluhu fi 'amain), do saal ke andar andar doodh chhudane ki muddat hai. Hazrat Usman (R.A) unka inkar na kar sake aur foran aadmi bheja ke is aurat ko wapas karo. Yahan bhi lafz (Abada) hai, yani inkar na kar sake. Ibn-e-Wahb (R.H) kehte hain (Abada) ke ma'ani na manna, inkar karna hai. Shair ke sher mein bhi (Abada) inkar ke aur na manne ke ma'ani mein hai. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, is liye ke shart ke jawab mein yeh kuch theek tor par lagta nahin. Ise manne ke baad matlab yeh hoga ke agar Rahman ki aulad hai to main pehla munkir hoon aur is mein kalam ki khoobsurti qaim nahin rehti. Haan sirf yeh keh sakte hain ke (In) shart ke liye nahin hai balkay nafi ke liye hai, jaise ke Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se manqool bhi hai. To ab mazmoon-e-kalam yeh hoga ke chunke Rahman ki aulad nahin, pas main uska pehla gawah hoon. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain yeh kalam Arab ke muhawaray ke mutabiq hai, yani na Rahman ki aulad, na main uska qail-o-aabid. Abu Sakhr (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke main to pehle hi uska aabid hoon ke uski aulad hai hi nahin aur main uski tauheed ko manne mein bhi aagay aagay hoon. Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain main uska pehla ibadat guzar hoon aur muwahhid hoon aur tumhari takzeeb karne wala hoon.

Imam Bukhari (R.H) farmate hain main pehla inkari hoon yeh dono lughat mein (Aabid) aur (Abd) aur awwal hi zyada qareeb hai is wajah se ke yeh shart-o-jaza hai lekin yeh mumtani aur muhaal mehaz namumkin. Suddi (R.H) farmate hain agar is ki aulad hoti toh main ise pehle maan leta ke is ki aulad hai lekin woh is se paak hai. Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur jo log (An) ko nafiya batlate hain un ke qaul ki tardeed karte hain. Isi liye Bari Ta'ala Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur tamam cheezon ka haal is se paak bahut door aur bilkul munazzah hai ke is ki aulad ho. Woh Fard, Ahad, Samad hai, is ki nazeer, kufw, aulad koi nahin. Irshad hota hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) inhe apni jahalat mein ghote khate chhodo aur duniya ke khel tamashon mein mashghool rehne do, isi ghaflat mein in par Qayamat toot padegi. Us waqt apna anjam maloom kar lenge. Phir Zaat-e-Haq ki buzurgi aur azmat aur jalal ka mazeed bayan hota hai ke zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooqat is ki aabid hai, is ke samne past aur aajiz hai. Woh sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik, sab ko basane aur banane wala, sab par hukumat aur saltanat rakhne wala, badi barkaton wala hai. Woh tamam aibon se, kul nuqsanat se paak hai, woh sab ka malik hai, bulandiyon aur azmaton wala hai, koi nahin jo is ka hukum taal sake, koi nahin jo is ki marzi badal sake, har ek par qabiz wahi hai, har ek kaam is ki qudrat ke tahat hai. Jahalat-o-khabasat, kund zehni aur be-waqoofi itni badh gayi hai ke aisi seedhi si baat marte dam tak samajh na aayi.
